title.zh: 机器人行动之前
title.en: Before the robot moves

text.zh: 机器人面前有一只杯子，靠近桌子边缘。它可以靠近杯柄、推动杯子，或者移动相机看看被遮挡的一侧。起始图像完全相同，不同选择却会带来不同后果。世界模型让机器人有机会在行动之前预测这些后果。这套课程围绕这只杯子，从相机观测讲到预测未来、选择动作和实际结果。杯子场景是我们的教学示例，不是某篇论文已经完成的实验。
text.en: A robot faces a cup near the edge of a table. It could approach the handle, push the cup, or move its camera to see the hidden side. Each choice changes what happens next, even though the starting image is identical. A world model gives the robot a way to predict those consequences before committing to an action. This course follows that cup from a camera observation through imagined futures, action selection, and a real outcome. The cup sequence is our teaching example, not a claimed experiment from a paper.

title.zh: 一张图像，不等于完整状态
title.en: An image is not the full state

text.zh: 相机测量可见表面传来的光，并不能直接测到决定运动的一切因素。杯子在一帧中看起来静止，实际上却可能正滑向桌边。它的质量、摩擦、内部物品和与夹爪的接触，也可能部分不可见。传感器能提供的读数叫观测；预测过程所需的信息构成状态。模型内部学到的状态是一种估计，并不是对整个物理世界的直接透视。
text.en: The camera measures light arriving from visible surfaces; it does not directly measure everything that determines motion. A cup can look stationary in one frame while actually sliding toward the edge. Its mass, friction, contents, and contact with the gripper may also be partly hidden. We call the available sensor reading an observation, and the information needed to predict the process its state. A learned internal state is an estimate, not a privileged view of the complete physical world.

title.zh: 历史观测改变判断
title.en: History changes what the robot knows

text.zh: 相隔片刻的两张图像，可以揭示杯子的滑动方向。关节传感器和之前的夹爪指令，还能补充单靠相机看不到的信息。模型结合这些测量和记忆，更新对当前情况的内部判断。如果两种不同物理状态都符合已有证据，就应保留不确定性，而不是假定它已经消失。因此，移动相机即使没有立刻推进抓取，也可能改善下一次决策。
text.en: Two images taken a moment apart can reveal the direction of the sliding cup. Joint sensors and the previous gripper command add information that the camera alone may miss. The model combines these measurements with its memory to update an internal belief about the current situation. If two different physical states still fit the evidence, uncertainty should remain rather than vanish by assumption. A moving camera may therefore improve the next decision even when it makes no immediate progress toward grasping.

title.zh: 动作必须有明确含义
title.en: An action needs an exact meaning

text.zh: 预测动作的后果，首先要知道这个动作究竟是什么意思。向右移动，可能指图像位移、关节目标，也可能指机器人基坐标系中的笛卡尔指令。时间间隔同样重要：相同速度持续不同时间，会产生不同运动。可用于机器人的模型，需要明确的控制接口、一致的单位，以及同步的观测和指令。缺少这些约定，再惊艳的预测视频，也无法告诉控制器该发送什么信号。
text.en: Predicting what happens after an action requires knowing exactly what that action means. Move right could mean an image displacement, a joint target, or a Cartesian command in the robot base frame. The time interval matters too: the same velocity applied for different durations produces different motion. A useful robot model needs a documented control interface, consistent units, and synchronized observations and commands. Without that agreement, an impressive predicted video cannot tell the controller what signal to send.

title.zh: 未来可能是一种分布
title.en: The future may be a distribution

text.zh: 假设机器人推动一只从未看过杯底的杯子。从同一个可见起点出发，不同摩擦可能对应多个合理的停止位置。这种歧义来自信息不完整；过程本身的变化还会增加另一种不确定性。只返回一个平均位置，可能掩盖杯子会掉下桌子的关键可能性。对未来采样能够展现不同可能，但只有模型捕捉到相关变化时，这些样本才有参考价值。
text.en: Suppose the robot pushes a cup whose underside it has never seen. Different friction values could produce several plausible stopping positions from the same visible starting point. This ambiguity comes from incomplete information; genuine process variation can add another source of uncertainty. Returning one average position may hide the important possibility that the cup falls off the table. Sampling possible futures can expose alternatives, but those samples are trustworthy only if the model captures the relevant variation.

title.zh: 重建与预测回答不同问题
title.en: Reconstruction asks a different question

text.zh: 重建图像，是把一个观测编码后，再恢复这个观测中的信息。预测未来，则是根据历史和可能动作，估计尚未观测到的内容。精细的三维杯子网格有助于理解几何，却不会自动预测滑动或泼洒。反过来，有用的预测器也可以只处理紧凑特征，从不生成照片般真实的图像。要问清楚：这种表示保留了哪种未来信息，又打算支持什么决策。
text.en: Reconstructing an image means encoding an observation and recovering information from that observation. Predicting a future means estimating something that has not yet been observed, given history and possible actions. A detailed three-dimensional cup mesh can help with geometry, but it does not by itself predict sliding or spilling. Conversely, a useful predictor may operate on compact features without ever producing a photorealistic image. Ask which future quantity the representation preserves, and which decision that quantity is intended to support.

title.zh: 用紧凑状态承载预测
title.en: A compact state can carry the prediction

text.zh: 沿着这张原图，从观测编码器走到内部变量。模型把递归记忆与随机表示结合起来，再通过动作推进它们。解码器可以把内部状态还原成图像，用于训练或检查。右侧想象过程中的动作与价值计算，并不需要把每个未来都渲染成图像。这种分离允许系统比较或学习大量紧凑轨迹，但每条轨迹仍然依赖模型的准确性。
text.en: Follow the original diagram from the observation encoder into the internal variables. The model combines a recurrent memory with a stochastic representation, then advances them using an action. A decoder can turn the internal state back into an image for training or inspection. The imagined action and value computations on the right do not require rendering every future image. This separation makes it possible to compare or learn from many compact trajectories, although every trajectory still depends on model accuracy.

title.zh: 预测来自转移数据
title.en: Predictions are learned from transitions

text.zh: 对于这只杯子，一条有用的训练记录包含观测、实际执行的指令，以及下一次观测。如果学习算法需要，还可以记录奖励和回合结束信息。模型从大量这样的转移中学习规律，其中也应包括没有成功的动作。只包含轻推的数据，对碰撞、跌落或陌生杯子材质提供的证据很有限。生成更多想象轨迹，并不会凭空增加这些缺失环节的物理证据。
text.en: For our cup, one useful training record contains an observation, an executed command, and the following observation. Reward and termination information can be recorded as well when the learning algorithm needs them. The model learns regularities across many such transitions, including actions that did not succeed. A dataset containing only gentle pushes provides weak evidence about collisions, drops, or unfamiliar cup materials. Imagining more rollouts does not create new physical evidence about those missing parts of the task.

title.zh: 一条路线：行动前搜索
title.en: One route searches before acting

text.zh: 使用模型的一种方式，是提出多组未来指令序列，预测各自的后果。例如，比较直接靠近杯柄，和先绕过障碍物再靠近。任务目标为预测结果评分，例如同时考虑进展与靠近桌边的代价。控制器执行所选序列的第一个动作，观察实际发生了什么，再重新规划。这种反复修正就是模型预测控制；只有预测质量和计算预算允许时，看得更远才有价值。
text.en: One way to use the model is to propose several future command sequences and predict their consequences. For example, compare approaching the handle directly with moving around an obstacle first. A task objective scores the predicted outcomes, perhaps combining progress with penalties for approaching the table edge. The controller executes the first selected action, observes what really happened, and plans again. This repeated correction is model predictive control; searching farther is useful only when prediction quality and computation allow it.

title.zh: 另一条路线：在想象中训练策略
title.en: Another route trains a policy in imagination

text.zh: Dreamer 使用学到的模型，在想象轨迹上训练动作策略和价值估计器。获得真实环境观测后，策略便能根据推断出的内部状态选择动作。它不需要在每个控制步骤都执行同样的候选序列搜索。这张图区分了真实经验、回放数据、世界模型学习，以及策略改进。行动选择时规划，与训练时使用想象，是两种不同的计算安排，即使它们都依赖学到的动力学。
text.en: Dreamer uses the learned model to train an actor and a value estimator on imagined trajectories. After observing the real environment, the actor can then choose an action from the inferred internal state. It does not need to run the same candidate-sequence search at every control step. The diagram separates real experience, the replay buffer, world-model learning, and policy improvement. Planning during action selection and using imagination during training are different computational choices, even when both rely on learned dynamics.

title.zh: 实体机器人证据从哪里开始
title.en: Where the physical evidence starts

text.zh: DayDreamer 在四种实体机器人平台上测试了这条学习路线，包括两种机械臂、四足机器人和轮式机器人。机械臂使用相机输入及其配置中的其他信号，学习抓取放置任务。这些实验证明：在论文报告的配置下，想象训练能够支持真实控制。它们并没有证明，任意新机器人都能不经准备就安全学会任意任务。观看视频时，还要结合控制接口、奖励设计、采集时间和人工干预规则一起理解。
text.en: DayDreamer tested this learning approach on four physical robot platforms, including two arms, a quadruped, and a wheeled robot. The arms learned pick-and-place tasks using camera inputs and other configured signals. These experiments demonstrate that imagined training can support real control under the reported setup. They do not establish that every new robot can safely learn any task without preparation. Read the control interface, reward design, collection time, and intervention rules alongside the videos.

title.zh: 闭环修正，也要知道模型边界
title.en: Close the loop without trusting it blindly

text.zh: 机器人预测杯子能稳定抬起，真实杯子却在夹爪加速时开始滑落。下一次观测能够暴露这种不一致，触发状态更新和动作调整。但这只有在传感器足够早发现问题、控制器仍来得及响应时才有帮助。模型置信度不是物理保证，漂亮的未来图像也不是接触力测量。应独立设置运动限制，对照预测与实测，并保留失败试次以便诊断。
text.en: Our robot predicts a stable lift, but the real cup starts slipping when the gripper accelerates. The next observation can expose the mismatch and trigger a new estimate and a revised action. That helps only if the sensors detect the problem early enough and the controller can still respond. Model confidence is not a physical guarantee, and an attractive future image is not a contact-force measurement. Keep independent limits on motion, compare predictions with measurements, and retain the failed trials for diagnosis.

title.zh: 接下来，逐层打开世界模型
title.en: The map for the next five chapters

text.zh: 现在问题已经明确：给定机器人看到的内容，以及它可能采取的动作，接下来会发生什么？下一章拆开表示、递归状态、奖励预测和不确定性。随后比较在线规划和想象中学到的策略，再研究视频与特征预测系统。最后两章将这些模型接入机器人策略，并建立区分画面质量与任务成功的评测协议。你可以在伴读实验里改变一个假设，观察预测结果的哪一部分随之变化。
text.en: We now have a precise question: given what the robot has observed and what it might do, what happens next? Next we unpack representations, recurrent state, reward prediction, and uncertainty. Then we compare online planning with policies learned in imagination, and examine video and feature-prediction systems. The final chapters connect these models to robot policies and build an evaluation protocol that keeps visual quality separate from task success. Use the companion experiments to change one assumption and see which part of the predicted outcome changes.

title.zh: 模型应该记住什么？
title.en: What should the model remember?

text.zh: 杯子正在运动，但模型的记忆和计算资源有限。它可以保留每个像素，跟踪明确的位置与速度，也可以把场景压缩成学习到的特征。这些选择决定哪些变化容易预测，哪些细节可能消失。一种表示是否有用，取决于它为未来决策保留了什么信息，而不是这些数字看起来是否容易解释。现在，我们沿着信息流动的路径，一步一步打开模型。
text.en: Our cup is moving, but the model has limited memory and computation. It could preserve every pixel, track explicit position and velocity, or compress the scene into learned features. These choices determine which changes are easy to predict and which details might disappear. A representation is useful because of the information it keeps for future decisions, not because its numbers look interpretable. We will now follow the information through the model one step at a time.

title.zh: 几何是一种状态描述
title.en: Geometry is one possible state description

text.zh: 显式模型可以在已知坐标系中保存杯子位姿、物体速度和机器人构型。网格或点云提供几何信息，另外的变量描述运动与接触。这种结构便于碰撞查询和调试，但感知系统必须估计出所需的量。即使网格非常精细，缺少质量或摩擦信息仍然会造成建模问题。因此，显式表示只是把一部分困难移到了状态估计，并不会自行消除不确定性。
text.en: An explicit model might store the cup pose, object velocity, and the robot configuration in known coordinates. A mesh or point cloud provides geometric information, while additional variables describe motion and contact. This structure can make collision queries and debugging convenient, but perception must estimate the required quantities. Missing mass or friction still creates a modeling problem even if the mesh is very detailed. An explicit representation therefore moves some difficulty into estimation; it does not remove uncertainty by itself.

title.zh: 潜变量是学习出来的信息容器
title.en: A latent vector is learned storage

text.zh: 潜在表示用从数据中学到的向量，替代部分人工设计的变量。编码器把观测映射到内部空间；其中数值相近，不一定代表物理位置相近。训练决定哪些差异值得保留，例如运动与静止、抓住与松开，或者不同的预期奖励。紧凑向量让系统能够计算大量未来轨迹，而不用反复生成大幅图像。代价是，看起来平滑的潜空间转移，也可能隐藏着重要的物理错误。
text.en: A latent representation replaces some hand-designed variables with a vector learned from data. The encoder maps an observation into this internal space, where nearby values need not correspond to nearby physical positions. Training decides which distinctions remain useful: moving versus stationary, grasped versus released, or different expected rewards. Small vectors allow many future trajectories to be computed without repeatedly generating large images. The cost is that an apparently smooth latent transition can conceal a physically important error.

title.zh: 记忆与不确定性承担不同任务
title.en: Memory and uncertainty play different roles

text.zh: 递归状态空间模型，简称 RSSM，把确定性的记忆与随机潜变量结合起来。记忆把先前状态和动作的信息带到后面，例如杯子之前已经在滑动的证据。随机部分表示在考虑历史后仍然存在的不同可能性。在原论文的比较中，纯确定性递归模型与纯随机模型是不同设计。把两者结合，是一种建模选择，并不证明所有隐藏物理变量都已经恢复。
text.en: The recurrent state-space model, or RSSM, combines a deterministic memory with stochastic latent variables. The memory carries information forward from previous states and actions, such as evidence that our cup was already sliding. The stochastic part represents alternatives that remain after accounting for that history. In the original comparison, a purely deterministic recurrent model and a purely stochastic model are distinct design choices. Combining them is a modeling decision, not proof that every hidden physical variable has been recovered.

title.zh: 后验：用真实观测更新
title.en: Posterior: update with the actual observation

text.zh: 下一张真实相机图像到来时，模型先利用已执行的动作，把之前的记忆向前推进。随后结合这一步预测与新观测，推断后验状态。如果杯子移动得比预期少，观测可以纠正内部估计，而不是盲目延续旧预测。这是状态估计的更新，并不意味着神经网络的所有参数都会立刻改变。更新当前状态判断与训练模型权重，是不同操作，往往也采用不同频率。
text.en: At the next real camera frame, the model first carries its previous memory forward using the executed action. It then combines that prediction with the new observation to infer a posterior state. If the cup moved less than expected, the observation can correct the internal estimate instead of blindly continuing the old forecast. This is a state-estimation update; it does not automatically change all the neural-network parameters. Updating the current belief and training the model weights happen through different operations and often at different rates.

title.zh: 先验：没有新画面也要继续预测
title.en: Prior: continue without seeing the answer

text.zh: 在想象轨迹中，下一个真实观测并不存在，因为动作还没有发生。模型只能根据记忆和提出的动作历史，采样或预测先验潜在状态。这个预测状态又成为下一步想象的输入，因此误差可能逐步累积。每一步都重新输入录像中的未来图像，测试的是受观测条件约束的估计，而不是更难的开环预测。必须标明：真实观测在哪一步停止，模型生成状态从哪里开始接替。
text.en: During an imagined rollout, the next real observation is unavailable because the action has not happened yet. The model must sample or predict a prior latent state using only its memory and the proposed action history. That predicted state becomes input to the next imagined step, which makes multi-step errors possible. Feeding recorded future images back into every step tests observation-conditioned estimation instead of this harder open-loop prediction. Always mark the exact point where real observations stop and model-generated states take over.

title.zh: 为什么还要重建？
title.en: Why reconstruct at all?

text.zh: 重建目标要求内部状态保留能够解释观测输入的信息。缺少有信息量的目标时，编码器可能为每个场景输出几乎相同的特征，让预测变得毫无意义地简单。但是，保存所有可见细节，也可能把模型容量耗在与控制无关的背景或纹理上。TD-MPC2 等无解码器方法，则通过与控制目标相关的量和一致性损失来训练表示。移除像素重建改变了学习问题，却没有免除保留任务相关差异的要求。
text.en: A reconstruction objective forces the internal state to retain information that explains the observed inputs. Without informative objectives, an encoder could output nearly identical features for every scene and make prediction trivially easy. However, preserving all visible detail may spend capacity on backgrounds or textures that do not matter for control. Decoder-free approaches such as TD-MPC2 instead train representations through quantities and consistency losses relevant to their control objective. Removing pixel reconstruction changes the learning problem; it does not remove the need to preserve task-relevant distinctions.

title.zh: 让先验与后验彼此匹配
title.en: Make the prior and posterior compatible

text.zh: 后验可以访问先验看不到的观测。散度项训练先验，让它能够预测后验根据观测推断出的状态。同类目标还会鼓励形成动力学模型能够预测的表示。两种压力需要平衡：表示过于简单会丢失信息，先验不准确则会让想象不可靠。DreamerV2 和 V3 使用经过区分的梯度路径与平衡设计，而不是把所有部分当作可互换的预测损失。
text.en: The posterior has access to an observation that the prior does not see. A divergence term trains the prior to predict states that the observation-informed posterior would produce. The same family of objectives also encourages representations that the dynamics model can predict. These pressures must be balanced: overly simple representations can lose information, while an inaccurate prior makes imagination unreliable. DreamerV2 and V3 use carefully separated gradient paths and balancing choices rather than treating every component as an interchangeable prediction loss.

title.zh: Dreamer 各代改变了什么？
title.en: What changed across Dreamer generations?

text.zh: 最初的 Dreamer 使用连续随机潜变量，通过想象中的潜在轨迹学习行为。DreamerV2 引入类别型潜变量与平衡技术，并在其 Atari 评测设置中取得较好结果。类别型潜编码是模型内部的信息存储方式，并不意味着实体机器人必须使用离散关节指令。DreamerV3 增加了面向不同输入、奖励和回报尺度的稳定训练设计，以适应多种任务领域。这些变化属于完整学习系统，因此比较时要对齐整套训练与评测配置。
text.en: The original Dreamer learns behavior through imagined latent trajectories, using continuous stochastic latent variables. DreamerV2 introduces categorical latent variables and balancing techniques, with strong results in its Atari evaluation setting. A categorical latent code is internal model storage; it does not mean the physical robot must use discrete joint commands. DreamerV3 adds robustness techniques for different scales of inputs, rewards, and returns across diverse task domains. These are changes to a complete learning system, so comparison requires matching the full training and evaluation setup.

title.zh: 不确定性的两种来源
title.en: Two sources of uncertainty

text.zh: 杯子滑动不同，可能是过程存在变化，也可能是模型还不了解这种材质。前者涉及给定可用信息后仍然存在的变化；后者涉及学习到的预测器缺少知识。随机潜变量模型可以表示多个未来，却不一定能说明这种分散来自哪一类不确定性。集成模型能够揭示多个拟合模型之间的分歧，但它们达成一致，也不能证明在训练分布之外预测正确。在用置信度支持后果重大的决策前，需要独立的留出数据校准测试。
text.en: The cup may slide differently because the process varies, or because the model has not learned this material well. The first concerns variability that remains given the available information; the second concerns missing knowledge in the learned predictor. A stochastic latent model can represent multiple futures without necessarily telling us which uncertainty source caused the spread. An ensemble can reveal disagreement between fitted models, but agreement does not establish correctness outside the training distribution. Confidence needs its own held-out calibration test before it guides high-consequence decisions.

title.zh: 单步准确，也可能长期漂移
title.en: One-step accuracy can hide drift

text.zh: 假设模型存在微小偏差，让每次预测推动都把杯子移得稍远一点。单步评测可能只显示小误差，因为每次预测都从真实观测状态开始。开环滚动预测反复使用自身输出，因此位置偏差会改变后续接触的条件。一旦漏掉接触，误差可能突然放大，而不是随着预测长度平滑增长。应按实际预测时间绘制误差，并在相同动作序列下比较有观测校正与无校正的轨迹。
text.en: Imagine a small bias that makes every predicted push move the cup slightly too far. One-step evaluation may show a modest error because each prediction starts from a real observed state. An open-loop rollout repeatedly uses its own output, so the position bias changes the conditions for later contacts. Once a contact is missed, the error may grow abruptly rather than increase smoothly with horizon. Plot error against physical prediction time, and compare corrected rollouts with uncorrected ones under the same action sequence.

title.zh: 围绕任务选择保留的信息
title.en: Choose information for the task

text.zh: 对于靠近可见杯子的动作，近似位置可能足以选择有用的第一步。对于抬起易滑杯子，模型可能需要接触、夹爪状态与近期运动，才能区分成功和失败。对于倒水，朝向和内部液体变化变得重要，即使外部形状几乎没有变化。不存在一种仅凭名称就能保证有用的表示。应先定义决策与测量，再测试所选状态能否在留出场景中支持这些决策。
text.en: For reaching toward a visible cup, approximate position may be enough to choose a useful first motion. For lifting a slippery cup, the model may need contact, gripper state, and recent motion to distinguish success from failure. For pouring, orientation and the changing contents become relevant even when the external shape barely changes. There is no single representation whose usefulness follows from its name alone. Define the decisions and measurements first, then test whether the chosen state supports those decisions on held-out situations.

title.zh: 从内部状态走向决策
title.en: From internal state to a decision

text.zh: 现在，我们可以不用“理解物理”这种模糊说法来描述模型。应说明它观测什么、怎样记住历史、预测哪些未来变量，以及这些预测如何训练。接着检查不确定性和预测误差从链路的哪里进入。下一章通过轨迹搜索、终端价值，以及在模型中训练的策略，把这些预测转变成动作。同一套学习状态可以支持不同决策过程，它们的在线计算成本和失败方式也会不同。
text.en: We can now describe the model without using the vague phrase that it understands physics. Specify what it observes, how it remembers history, which future variables it predicts, and how those predictions are trained. Then inspect where uncertainty and prediction error enter the chain. The next chapter turns these predictions into actions through trajectory search, terminal values, and actors trained inside the model. The same learned state can support different decision procedures, with different online compute costs and different failure modes.

title.zh: 有了预测，还缺一个决策规则
title.en: A prediction still needs a decision rule

text.zh: 假设模型预测了三种未来：杯子保持不动、滑向目标，或者倾倒。它还没有决定哪个结果值得追求，也没有决定执行哪条指令。我们还需要目标函数、动作选择过程，以及处理有限计算资源的方法。这一章沿两条不同路线展开：在决策时搜索未来，以及提前利用想象的未来训练策略。两条路线都使用世界模型，但把计算花在了不同位置。
text.en: Suppose our model predicts three futures: the cup stays still, slides toward the target, or tips over. It has not yet decided which outcome is desirable or which command to execute. We need an objective, an action-selection procedure, and a way to handle limited computation. This chapter follows two different routes: searching through futures at decision time, and training a policy using imagined futures beforehand. Both use a world model, but they spend their computation in different places.

title.zh: 先定义什么是好轨迹
title.en: Define what a good trajectory means

text.zh: 在教学例子中，可以奖励到达目标，并惩罚倾倒或过大的运动。规划器评估一串动作，因为第一步看似平淡的运动，可能为后面的有效接触做准备。具体奖励、折扣、规划长度和约束，共同决定哪串动作最优。即使模型能准确预测图像，也不会因此自动发现用户真正的偏好。评分中的惩罚项，也不等于控制器能够保证的硬约束。
text.en: For our teaching example, a useful score could reward reaching the target and penalize tipping or excessive motion. A planner evaluates a sequence, because a harmless first movement can prepare a useful later contact. The exact reward, discount, horizon, and constraints determine which sequence looks best. A model does not discover the user's true preferences merely by predicting images accurately. And a penalty in the score is not the same as a hard constraint that the controller guarantees.

title.zh: CEM 改进的是候选分布

text.zh: 交叉熵方法从动作序列的分布开始，通常用均值和方差描述。它采样候选序列，用学习的动力学逐个推演，并评价预测结果。表现最好的子集成为精英集合，用它拟合下一轮采样分布。不断重复，搜索就集中到有希望的序列附近，PlaNet 的潜空间规划采用了这种做法。这里的动画演示这一机制，画出的路径并不是机器人实验测量结果。
text.en: The cross-entropy method begins with a distribution over action sequences, often described by means and variances. It samples candidates, rolls each through the learned dynamics, and scores the predicted outcomes. The best subset becomes the elite set, from which the next sampling distribution is fitted. Repeating this process concentrates the search around promising sequences, as in PlaNet's latent-space planning. The animation illustrates that mechanism; its drawn paths are not measurements from a robot experiment.

title.zh: MPC 只执行一步，再重新观察
title.en: MPC executes one step, then looks again

text.zh: 优化后，模型预测控制执行第一个动作，而不是盲目承诺整串序列。相机观察实际发生了什么，状态估计得到更新，然后重新规划。只要感知和计算足够及时，这种反馈就能纠正杯子实际移动小于预测的情况。更长的规划范围可以看到延迟奖励，却也需要更多计算，并暴露更多模型误差。重新规划有助于处理不确定性，但不会让错误的动力学自动消失。
text.en: After optimization, model-predictive control executes the first action, rather than blindly committing to the entire sequence. The camera observes what actually happened, the state estimate is updated, and planning starts again. This feedback can correct a cup that moved less than predicted, provided sensing and computation arrive in time. Longer horizons can reveal delayed rewards, but they also require more computation and expose more model error. Replanning helps manage uncertainty; it does not make inaccurate dynamics disappear.

title.zh: 短期规划可以接上终端价值
title.en: A short horizon can use a terminal value

text.zh: 有限长度的推演只预测接下来几步，但任务可能持续更久。因此，TD-MPC 把近期预测奖励与规划末端的学习价值估计结合起来。策略先验还提供有希望的候选动作，减少对无信息随机采样的依赖。这体现的是规划与学习行为的合作，而不是必须二选一。不过，即使短期转移看起来准确，过于乐观的终端价值也可能误导规划器。
text.en: A finite rollout only predicts the next few steps, while the task may continue much longer. TD-MPC therefore combines predicted near-term rewards with a learned value estimate at the end of the horizon. The policy prior also contributes promising candidate actions, reducing dependence on uninformed sampling. This is a cooperation between planning and learned behavior, rather than a choice that excludes one or the other. However, an optimistic terminal value can mislead the planner even when short-term transitions look accurate.

title.zh: Dreamer 把一部分决策计算移入训练
title.en: Dreamer moves search effort into learning

text.zh: Dreamer 从回放数据中推断出的真实经验状态出发，生成想象轨迹。策略选择想象动作，世界模型预测后续状态与奖励，价值网络估计未来回报。这些推演能够改进策略和价值网络，而不用在环境里执行每一个候选动作。部署时，训练好的策略可以直接从推断状态选择动作。因此，在模型中学习行为，并不意味着每条电机指令之前都进行在线轨迹搜索。
text.en: Dreamer starts imagined trajectories from states inferred from real experience in its replay buffer. The actor chooses imagined actions, the world model predicts subsequent states and rewards, and the critic estimates future return. These rollouts improve the actor and critic without executing every proposed action in the environment. At deployment, the trained actor can directly select an action from the inferred state. Learning behavior inside a model therefore does not imply running an online trajectory search before every motor command.

text.zh: 第一版 Dreamer 强调用想象潜在轨迹的梯度，在连续控制中学习行为。DreamerV2 引入类别潜变量，并调整学习配方，包括平衡的散度项。DreamerV3 通过处理数值尺度、归一化等改动，提高跨领域的稳健性。这些版本共享基于想象的策略价值结构，但分布形式和优化细节不能互换。类别潜在状态，也不意味着物理机器人必须使用离散电机动作。
text.en: The first Dreamer emphasized learning behavior through gradients of imagined latent trajectories in continuous control. DreamerV2 introduced categorical latent variables and a revised learning recipe, including balanced divergence terms. DreamerV3 focuses on robustness across domains through changes such as scale handling and normalization. These versions share the imagination-based actor-critic structure, but their distributions and optimization details are not interchangeable. A categorical latent state also does not mean the physical robot must use discrete motor actions.

title.zh: MuZero 学习的是对搜索有用的模型
title.en: MuZero learns a model useful for search

text.zh: MuZero 提供了第三种对照：学习表示把观测历史转成搜索起始状态。动力学函数预测动作之后的下一个隐藏状态与奖励。预测函数提供价值与策略先验，引导蒙特卡洛树搜索。原始训练目标面向这些决策相关量，不要求重建图像。因此，棋类与 Atari 评测中的成功支持任务导向规划，而不是证明它拥有完整物理仿真器或机器人控制器。
text.en: MuZero supplies a third useful comparison: a learned representation initializes a search state from observation history. Its dynamics function predicts the next hidden state and reward after an action. A prediction function supplies values and policy priors, which guide Monte Carlo tree search. The original training objective targets these decision-relevant quantities without requiring image reconstruction. Success in its board-game and Atari evaluations therefore supports task-oriented planning, rather than demonstrating a complete physical simulator or a robot controller.

title.zh: 沿着计算发生的位置读方法
title.en: Track where the computation happens

text.zh: 阅读新方法时，沿流程图追踪四个问题：谁预测、谁评分、谁选择，以及最终执行什么。接着区分训练阶段推演与决策阶段推演，并找出真实观测在哪里重新进入。这样就不会把世界模型与规划器混为一谈，也不会把学习策略等同于生成视频。下一章把同样的问题用于预测表示、交互视频世界，以及连接视频与机器人动作的新模型。
text.en: When reading a new method, trace four questions through its diagram: what predicts, what scores, what chooses, and what is executed. Then separate training-time rollouts from decision-time rollouts, and identify where real observations return. This prevents confusing a world model with its planner, or a learned policy with a generated video. The next chapter applies the same questions to predictive representations, interactive video worlds, and recent models that connect video and robot actions.

title.zh: 可信的画面，只是起点
title.en: A convincing future is only the beginning

text.zh: 看一只生成的人手伸向杯子，整个场景可能非常逼真。但模型究竟证明了什么？它也许只是根据提示生成了一段合理的视频。也许它预测了某个具体动作怎样改变场景。也可能这些预测确实帮助真机器人选出了成功的动作。这是不同的测试，需要不同的证据。最初的 Sora 研究报告已经说明：出色的视频生成，也可能伴随错误物理和物体状态缺失。
text.en: Watch a generated hand reach toward a cup, and the scene may look completely convincing. But what exactly has the model demonstrated? Perhaps it produced a plausible movie from a prompt. Perhaps it predicted how a particular action changes the scene. Or perhaps those predictions helped a real robot choose a successful action. These are different tests, requiring different evidence. The original Sora report already showed why: impressive video generation can coexist with incorrect physics and missing object state changes.

text.zh: 固定起始观测，比较两个可能的指令。一个让夹爪向左移动，另一个让夹爪闭合。动作条件世界模型应该为这两个输入预测不同后果。控制量必须有明确含义，可能是游戏按键，也可能是机器人位移。动作的文字描述可以作为条件，但不会自动变成经过标定的电机指令。比较视频模型时，首先要检查的就是这个动作接口。
text.en: Hold the starting observation fixed and compare two possible commands. One moves the gripper left; the other closes it. An action-conditioned world model should predict different consequences for those inputs. The control must have a defined meaning, whether it is a game key or a robot displacement. A text description of movement is a useful condition, but it does not automatically specify a calibrated motor command. This action interface is the first connection to inspect when comparing video models.

title.zh: 预测有用的特征
title.en: Predict useful features

text.zh: V-JEPA 2 走了另一条路线：预测目标是表征，而不是未来的每个像素。从左到右读这张原图。首先，编码器观察部分被遮挡的视频，预测器估计缺失区域的特征。预测目标来自指数移动平均编码器。这一阶段从大量视频中学习视觉表示。随后独立的动作条件阶段冻结编码器，学习机器人动作和位姿怎样改变这些特征。
text.en: V-JEPA 2 takes a different route: its prediction target is a representation, rather than every future pixel. Read the original figure from left to right. First, an encoder sees a partially masked video, and a predictor estimates features for the missing regions. The targets come from an exponential moving average encoder. This stage learns visual representations from large amounts of video. The separate action-conditioned stage then freezes the encoder and learns how robot actions and poses change those features.

title.zh: 无标签，不等于没有动作信息
title.en: Unlabeled does not mean action-free

text.zh: 机器人阶段使用不足六十二小时的 DROID 数据，但“无标签”需要准确理解。它指训练不需要任务名称、奖励或成功标签。视频仍然配有末端位置、朝向和夹爪状态。相邻状态之差构成七维动作输入。预测器既学习真实观测的特征历史，也学习将自身预测继续向前滚动。因此，这是不依赖任务标注的学习，并不是只靠完全没有动作信息的网络视频学会机器人控制。
text.en: The robot stage uses under sixty-two hours from DROID, but the word unlabeled needs care. It means the training does not need task names, rewards, or success labels. The videos still include end-effector position, orientation, and gripper state. Differences between consecutive states define seven-dimensional action inputs. The predictor learns both from observed feature histories and from short rollouts of its own predictions. So this is learning without task annotation, not learning physical robot control from completely action-free internet video.

title.zh: 准确读懂机器人证据
title.en: Read the robot evidence precisely

text.zh: V-JEPA 2-AC 在两间实验室的实体 Franka 机械臂上测试了到达、抓取和取放。取放使用了外部提供的多个图像子目标。这里的零样本指没有额外使用目标实验室的训练数据。它并不表示模型从未见过机器人轨迹。论文中的对照设置还需要在单张 GPU 上用十六秒规划一个动作。这证明了一个具体规划系统的能力，同时仍有相机和时域限制，不能直接称为实时通用操作。
text.en: V-JEPA 2-AC was tested on physical Franka arms in two laboratories, including reaching, grasping, and pick-and-place. Pick-and-place used several supplied image subgoals. Zero-shot here means no extra training data from those target laboratories. It does not mean the model had never seen robot trajectories. And the reported comparison used sixteen seconds to plan one action on a single GPU. That is evidence for a particular planning system, with camera and horizon limitations, not a claim of real-time universal manipulation.

title.zh: 从视频里发现控制量
title.en: Discover a control from video

text.zh: Genie 面对的是另一种缺失：网络视频通常没有记录产生画面的动作。它的潜动作模型把帧间变化压缩为离散编码。视频 tokenizer 描述场景，动力学模型再把视觉 tokens 与选定的动作编码结合。推理时，选择哪个编码会影响下一张生成图像。这让纯视频学习具有交互性，但编码不会自动成为以米或弧度计量的机器人命令。这种与物理控制量的对应关系仍需要另外建立。
text.en: Genie starts from a different missing ingredient: internet video often lacks the actions that produced it. Its latent-action model compresses changes between frames into discrete codes. The video tokenizer describes the scene, while the dynamics model combines visual tokens with the selected action code. At inference, choosing a code influences the next generated frame. This makes video-only learning interactive, but the code is not automatically a robot command in meters or radians. That physical correspondence would still need to be established.

text.zh: Genie 各代展示的是交互能力的演进，不能把它们视作一个可互换的模型。第一代论文报告大约每秒一帧，以及十六帧记忆。Genie 2 从初始图像出发，接受键盘与鼠标控制；多数公开例子持续十到二十秒。Genie 3 将其扩展到持续数分钟、七百二十 p 分辨率的交互场景。当前官方模型页报告每秒二十到二十四帧。这些数值描述具体版本，并不是对每一个生成世界的保证。
text.en: The Genie generations show a progression in interaction, not a single interchangeable model. The first paper reported about one frame per second and sixteen frames of memory. Genie 2 accepts keyboard and mouse controls from an initial image; most published examples lasted ten to twenty seconds. Genie 3 extended this to interactive scenes lasting minutes at seven-twenty-p resolution. Its current official page reports twenty to twenty-four frames per second. These figures describe specific releases, not guarantees for every generated world.

title.zh: 记忆，不只是镜头平滑
title.en: Memory is more than a smooth camera

text.zh: 想象给墙涂色，然后转身离开，再回头。一致的世界应该保留油漆的位置，而不是重新编造一面墙。因此，回访场景的演示，比镜头一直平滑向前更能说明问题。然而，视觉信息持续存在，并不能证明力、碰撞或任意交互都正确。Genie 3 仍明确说明动作空间有限，多独立智能体交互也有困难。SIMA 在生成世界里完成目标，属于虚拟智能体证据，必须与实体机器人验证分开。
text.en: Consider painting a wall, turning away, and returning. A consistent world should preserve where the paint went, rather than inventing a fresh wall. This is why revisitation demonstrations are more informative than a smooth forward camera movement. But visual persistence alone does not establish correct forces, collisions, or every possible interaction. Genie 3 still documents a limited action space and difficulty with multiple independent agents. SIMA completing goals inside that generated world is virtual-agent evidence, which must remain separate from physical robot validation.

title.zh: 视觉细节怎样影响学习
title.en: When visual details change learning

text.zh: 现在从提供交互世界，转向在世界模型内部训练策略。IRIS 将游戏图像编码为离散 tokens，并预测未来 tokens、奖励和回合结束。策略从这些想象轨迹中学习。DIAMOND 则用条件扩散预测未来图像。这张原始对比图标出了细小的不一致，包括砖块和奖励物体。即使整体画面看起来相似，丢掉这些细节也可能改变学习信号。这些是限定数据预算的 Atari 实验，不是实体机器人能力的测量。
text.en: Now switch from providing an interactive world to training a policy inside one. IRIS encodes game images as discrete tokens and predicts future tokens, rewards, and episode endings. Its policy learns from those imagined trajectories. DIAMOND instead predicts future images with conditional diffusion. The original comparison highlights small visual inconsistencies, including bricks and reward objects. Losing such details can change the learning signal, even when the overall picture looks similar. These are Atari experiments under specified data budgets, not measurements of physical robot competence.

title.zh: 扩散世界里的两只时钟
title.en: Two clocks inside a diffusion world

text.zh: 扩散世界模型里有两只不同的时钟。动作带来下一次观测时，环境时间向前推进。去噪时间则记录生成这次观测需要多少内部修正步骤。DIAMOND 的主要 Atari 实验使用三步去噪。另一个 Counter-Strike 演示使用固定的人类游戏记录和真人键鼠控制，并没有在其中训练强化学习代理。因此，一段可玩的生成视频能够展示学到的环境，却未必说明学到的策略有多好。
text.en: A diffusion world model has two different clocks. Environment time advances when an action leads to the next observation. Denoising time counts the internal refinement steps used to produce that observation. DIAMOND used three denoising steps in its main Atari experiments. Its separate Counter-Strike demonstration used fixed human gameplay data and human keyboard controls, without training an RL agent there. A playable video can therefore demonstrate a learned environment while saying little about the quality of a learned policy.

title.zh: 先看 Cosmos 的版本与接口
title.en: Read the Cosmos version and interface

text.zh: Cosmos 是一个家族，每项结论都应带上版本和接口。早期平台包含视频整理、tokenizer、基础模型和适配工具。Predict 生成未来视频；Transfer 用空间输入约束视觉生成；Reason 支持语言形式的物理推理。但这些用途之间并非永远不变的边界。到了二〇二六年初，Predict 2.5 也提供了机器人动作条件与策略配方。有用的比较必须明确具体权重、训练数据、输出，以及评测环境。
text.en: Cosmos is a family, so attach a version and an interface to every claim. The earlier platform combined video curation, tokenizers, foundation models, and adaptation tools. Predict generates future video; Transfer conditions visual generation on spatial inputs; Reason supports physical reasoning in language. But these are not permanent walls between capabilities. By early twenty twenty-six, Predict 2.5 also had robot action-conditioned and policy recipes. A useful comparison names the actual checkpoint, its training data, its outputs, and its evaluation environment.

title.zh: 同一个骨干，不同预测任务
title.en: One backbone, different prediction jobs

text.zh: Cosmos 3 通过共享理解、生成和动作的架构，让这种联系更加明确。原图将自回归分支与扩散分支结合起来。改变哪些量已知、哪些量需要预测，任务就会改变。给定动作，预测视频：这是正动力学。给定视觉变化，推断动作：这是逆动力学。同时预测动作和视频：这是策略配置。经过 DROID 后训练的策略有实体机器人证据；这些证据属于适配后的策略，不会自动适用于基础模型的每一种输出。
text.en: Cosmos 3 makes that connection explicit through a shared architecture for understanding, generation, and actions. Its original diagram combines an autoregressive stream with a diffusion stream. Change what is observed and what must be predicted, and the task changes. Given actions, predict video: forward dynamics. Given visual changes, infer actions: inverse dynamics. Jointly predict actions and video: a policy configuration. The DROID post-trained policy has physical robot evidence; that evidence belongs to the adapted policy, rather than automatically to every base-model output.

title.zh: 按用途选择证据
title.en: Choose the evidence for the job

text.zh: 选择世界模型时，先从你需要它完成的工作出发。用于数据生成，就检查覆盖范围，以及有用结构是否保留。用于规划，就检查动作标定、滚动预测误差和实测决策延迟。用于想象训练，就回到原环境评测训练出来的策略。用于机器人，就把实体任务结果与图像分数、仿真成功分开报告。当一个预测的具体接口与证据，匹配你真正要做的决策时，它才变得有用。
text.en: When choosing a world model, begin with the job you need it to do. For data generation, inspect coverage and whether useful structure survives. For planning, inspect action calibration, rollout errors, and measured decision latency. For imagined policy learning, evaluate the resulting policy in the original environment. For robotics, report physical task outcomes separately from image scores and simulated successes. A beautiful prediction becomes useful when its particular interface and evidence match the decision you want to make.

title.zh: 世界模型可以在四个位置帮忙
title.en: Four places where a world model can help

text.zh: 让机器人把杯子放到杯垫上，在手开始运动之前，就已经出现了多个决策问题。世界模型可以生成训练样本、提出视觉计划、帮助评估候选动作，或者支持视频与行为的联合学习。它们处在系统的不同位置，接收不同输入，也承担不同职责。我们把这些位置对应到具体论文，再为杯子任务构建明确标注的工程示例。
text.en: Give a robot the instruction to move a cup onto a coaster, and several decisions appear before the hand moves. A world model might generate training examples, suggest a visual plan, help evaluate candidate actions, or support joint learning of video and behavior. These are different positions in the system, with different inputs and different responsibilities. We will connect each position to a concrete paper, then build a clearly labeled engineering example for our cup task.

title.zh: 接口必须把图像接到指令上
title.en: The interface must connect images to commands

text.zh: 视觉语言动作策略接收观测与任务描述，再输出某种机器人接口下的指令。生成视频描述的则是一串可能出现的画面。要连接两者，就必须明确机器人形态、坐标系、单位、时间步，以及哪些信号被观察、哪些被预测。图像中的杯子向右移动，可能来自物体运动、相机运动，或者视角变化。缺少有依据的动作接口，视觉进展并不能唯一决定造成变化的指令。
text.en: A vision-language-action policy receives observations and a task description, then outputs commands in a particular robot interface. A generated video instead describes a possible sequence of appearances. To connect them, specify the robot embodiment, coordinate frame, units, time step, and which signals are observed or predicted. A cup moving right in image space could result from object motion, camera motion, or a different viewpoint. Without a grounded action interface, visual progress does not uniquely determine the command that caused it.

title.zh: UniPi 把视频计划转成动作
title.en: UniPi turns a video plan into actions

text.zh: UniPi 从当前图像与语言指令出发，生成描述可能任务轨迹的视频。逆动力学模型再把视觉转移转成目标环境里的动作。仔细看原流程图：视频生成器提出应该发生什么，逆模型估计怎样实现这种变化。这样，视觉规划接口与具体机器人形态的控制接口被分开。同时也带来两个失败位置：视觉计划本身不可实现，或者由它推断的动作错误。
text.en: UniPi starts from the current image and a language instruction, and generates a video describing a possible task trajectory. An inverse-dynamics model then converts visual transitions into actions for the target environment. Follow the original pipeline carefully: the video generator proposes what should happen, while the inverse model estimates how to produce that change. This separates a visual planning interface from the embodiment-specific control interface. It also creates two possible failure points: an impossible visual plan or an incorrect action inferred from it.

title.zh: 可以反馈，不等于实验已经反馈
title.en: A possible feedback loop is not the reported one

text.zh: UniPi 讨论了把组件放进模型预测控制循环，但明确把报告中的实验描述为开环。当杯子在计划执行到一半时滑动，这个区别就非常重要。开环执行不会自动根据变化后的场景重新生成计划。还要区分视频评估与机器人评估：分类器在生成末帧中识别成功，测量的是那段生成视频。这本身并不是物理机器人实际完成任务的成功率。
text.en: UniPi discusses applying its components in a model-predictive-control loop, but explicitly describes its reported experiments as open-loop. That distinction matters when the cup slips halfway through the plan. An open-loop execution does not automatically regenerate the plan from the changed scene. Also distinguish video evaluation from robot evaluation: a classifier recognizing success in a generated final frame measures that generated video. It is not, by itself, a measured rate of physically completed robot tasks.

title.zh: DreamGen 用模型生产训练数据
title.en: DreamGen uses a model to make training data

text.zh: DreamGen 把视频生成放在策略训练之前，而不是要求生成器在每个控制步运行。流程先让视频世界模型适配目标机器人，再根据起始图像与指令生成轨迹。潜在动作模型或逆动力学模型为生成的视觉转移补上伪动作。这些样本用于训练下游机器人策略。真正有用的问题是：在报告的数据与评估条件下，这些合成样本是否改善真实执行。
text.en: DreamGen places video generation before policy training rather than requiring the generator to run at every control step. Its pipeline first adapts a video world model to the target robot, then generates trajectories from initial images and instructions. A latent-action model or inverse-dynamics model supplies pseudo-actions for the generated visual transitions. The resulting examples are used to train a downstream robot policy. The useful question is whether those synthetic examples improve real execution under the reported data and evaluation conditions.

title.zh: 伪动作是估计，不是实测
title.en: Pseudo-actions are estimates, not measurements

text.zh: 假设生成轨迹显示杯子升起，但手指从未形成稳定接触。逆模型仍可能输出看起来合理的指令序列，因为它需要解释给定的视觉转移。这些标签是推断出来的，并不是在那个想象事件中测量到的。因此，合成数据质量需要检查指令一致性、动作合理性，以及下游是否真正受益。DreamGen 的机器人适配也使用采集的机器人数据，所以合成增强不能被描述为没有机器人经验就学会物理控制。
text.en: Suppose a generated trajectory shows the cup rising, but the fingers never form a stable contact. An inverse model may still output a plausible-looking command sequence, because it must explain the visual transition it was given. Those labels were inferred; they were not measured during the imagined event. Synthetic-data quality therefore needs checks for instruction alignment, action plausibility, and downstream usefulness. DreamGen's robot adaptation also uses collected robot data, so synthetic augmentation should not be described as learning physical control from no robot experience.

title.zh: GR-2 联合学习视频与行为
title.en: GR-2 jointly learns video and behavior

text.zh: GR-2 在同一学习系统中连接视频预测与动作生成。它先从大规模视频学习，再使用带动作的机器人轨迹适配。在原方法中，视频与动作是并行输出，动作分支包含条件变分组件。这与在线搜索许多想象未来、再选最优轨迹不同。机器人的底层控制频率也不能写成神经模型的决策频率；它们属于执行系统的不同层。
text.en: GR-2 connects video prediction and action generation inside a shared learning system. It first learns from large-scale video, then adapts using robot trajectories with actions. In the original method, video and action predictions are parallel outputs, with a conditional variational action component. This is different from searching many imagined futures online and choosing the best trajectory. And the robot's low-level controller frequency should not be reported as the neural model's decision frequency; those numbers belong to different layers of the execution stack.

title.zh: WorldVLA 共享视觉与动作预测
title.en: WorldVLA shares visual and action prediction

text.zh: 原版 WorldVLA 研究自回归系统，联合建模视觉信息与机器人动作。动作预测可以从理解视觉后果中受益，动作信息也可以帮助预测场景变化。它的注意力设计处理预测动作序列内部的依赖，包括动作误差累积的风险。应把它理解为一种具体的联合训练架构，并结合论文报告的 LIBERO 评估来读。加入世界建模目标，并不能证明部署时执行了显式在线 MPC，也不能证明它已经解决任意真实操作任务。
text.en: The original WorldVLA studies an autoregressive system that jointly models visual information and robot actions. Action prediction can benefit from understanding visual consequences, while action information can help predict scene changes. Its attention design addresses dependencies within predicted action sequences, including the risk of compounding action errors. Read this as a particular joint-training architecture with its reported LIBERO evaluation. The presence of a world-modeling objective does not establish that deployment performs explicit online MPC or that the system has already solved arbitrary physical manipulation.

title.zh: 运行时评估器是另一种接法
title.en: A runtime evaluator is another integration choice

text.zh: 现在构建一个工程示例，而不是把新实验归到上述论文名下。VLA 为移动杯子提出多个候选动作，动作条件模型预测它们的后果。任务评分排序候选，控制器只执行选中的第一步，然后重新观察。V-JEPA 2-AC 提供了特征空间规划的具体例子，但它不是这里完全相同的 VLA 候选架构。增加模型，需要用实测改进来证明价值，并与没有额外计算的同一策略比较。
text.en: Now build an engineering example, rather than attributing a new experiment to those papers. A VLA proposes several candidate actions for moving the cup, and an action-conditioned model predicts their consequences. A task score ranks candidates, while the controller executes only the selected first step and observes again. V-JEPA 2-AC provides a concrete example of feature-space planning, although it is not this exact VLA-candidate architecture. Adding a model should be justified by measured improvement over the same policy without that extra computation.

title.zh: 学习评判器不是独立安全证明
title.en: A learned judge is not an independent safety proof

text.zh: 在相似数据上训练的模型与策略，可能共享同一个盲点。两者都可能把透明杯子当成空处，或者漏掉手指背后的不稳定接触。因此，高预测奖励不能替代应用所需的关节限制、碰撞检查、控制器约束或直接测量。其中一些检查依靠几何或已知机器人机构，而不是学习预测器。应把模型置信度当成需要评估的一种信号，并明确观测与预测不一致时的退回行为。
text.en: A model and a policy trained on similar data may share the same blind spot. Both might treat a transparent cup as empty space or miss an unstable contact behind the fingers. A high predicted reward therefore cannot replace joint limits, collision checks, controller limits, or direct measurements needed by the application. Some of those checks use geometry or known robot mechanics rather than the learned predictor. Treat model confidence as one signal to evaluate, with explicit fallback behavior when observation and prediction disagree.

title.zh: 按照真实控制速度闭环
title.en: Close the loop at the actual control rate

text.zh: 现在杯子例子拥有完整循环：观察、估计、提议、预测、选择、执行，再次观察。但每个阶段都消耗时间，而部分计算运行时机器人仍在运动。基于旧画面的预测，在所选动作到达控制器之前就可能过时。需要测量端到端延迟，同步时间戳，并定义动作块如何中断或更新。合适的规划长度取决于这些时序，也取决于相关接触变化得有多快。
text.en: Our cup example now has a complete loop: observe, estimate, propose, predict, choose, execute, and observe again. But each stage consumes time, and the robot continues moving while some computations are running. A prediction based on an old frame can become stale before its selected action reaches the controller. Measure end-to-end latency, synchronize timestamps, and define how action chunks are interrupted or refreshed. The right planning horizon depends on those timings and on how rapidly the relevant contacts can change.

title.zh: 接触会暴露像素隐藏的误差
title.en: Contact exposes errors that pixels can hide

text.zh: 预测可见物体在自由空间中移动，与预测手指接触后的情况不同。很小的位姿误差，就可能改变手指是碰到杯沿、推动杯子，还是完全错过。摩擦、柔顺性与看不见的支撑条件，随后影响物体是升起还是滑落。视觉平滑的预测，可能掩盖这些突变，而不是解决它们。对这种应用，应评估接触转换与完整抓放结果，而不只是图像相似度或好看的生成抓握。
text.en: Moving a visible object across free space is different from predicting what happens when fingers make contact. A small pose error can change whether a finger touches the rim, pushes the cup, or misses it entirely. Friction, compliance, and unseen support conditions then affect whether the object lifts or slips. A visually smooth prediction may hide these discontinuities instead of resolving them. For this application, evaluate contact transitions and complete pick-and-place outcomes, not only image resemblance or an attractive generated grasp.

title.zh: 选择成本合理、确实有用的角色
title.en: Choose the least expensive useful role

text.zh: 如果部署算力紧张，合成数据可以把昂贵的视频建模移到离线阶段。如果任务有清楚的目标图像与校准动作，可以测试在线特征空间规划。如果动作标签与视频轨迹都可用，联合学习可以让不同目标共享有用表示。这些是带条件的设计选择，而不是论文名字的排名。应根据可用数据、传感器接口、控制时限，以及希望新增模型减少哪类失败来选择。
text.en: If deployment compute is tight, synthetic-data generation can move expensive video modeling into an offline stage. If the task has a clear goal image and calibrated actions, online feature-space planning may be a candidate to test. If action labels and video trajectories are available, joint learning can share useful representations across objectives. These are conditional design choices, not a ranking of paper names. Choose by the available data, sensor interface, control deadline, and the failure that the added model is meant to reduce.

title.zh: 沿每一个接口追踪证据
title.en: Follow the evidence across every interface

text.zh: 混合系统是否可信，取决于连接各阶段的证据。对于生成数据，要检查推断标签是否改善了独立评估的策略。对于视觉计划，要检查动作是否实现计划；对于运行时评估，要在相同预算下检查所选动作是否改善真实任务。把视频质量、动作预测与完整物理结果分开测量。最后一章把这些区别转成实际评测协议，保留失败，并让比较能够被正确解读。
text.en: A hybrid system is only as convincing as the evidence connecting its stages. For generated data, check whether inferred labels improve an independently evaluated policy. For visual plans, check whether actions realize them; for runtime evaluation, check whether the chosen action improves the real task under the same budget. Keep video quality, action prediction, and completed physical outcomes as separate measurements. The final chapter turns these distinctions into a practical evaluation protocol that preserves failures and makes comparisons interpretable.

title.zh: 先决定到底在测试什么
title.en: Decide what the model is being tested for

text.zh: 世界模型可能通过一项测试，却在另一项失败：它可以预测可信图像，却选出糟糕动作。首先区分表示质量、未来预测，以及使用这些预测的控制器表现。在杯子任务中，最终应用关心的是机器人能否在规定条件下完成要求的转移。中间指标用来解释发生了什么，但不能替代最终结果。这一章从采集数据、预测测试，一直建立到完整物理执行的评测协议。
text.en: A world model can pass one test and fail another: it may predict convincing images while choosing poor actions. Start by separating representation quality, future prediction, and the performance of the controller using those predictions. For our cup task, the final application asks whether the robot completes the requested transfer under defined conditions. Intermediate scores explain what happened, but they do not replace that outcome. This chapter builds a protocol from collected data through prediction tests to complete physical execution.

title.zh: 记录实际的状态转移接口
title.en: Record the actual transition interface

text.zh: 一条有用的机器人转移记录包含同步观测、实际执行指令、持续时间，以及相关机器人状态。同时保存坐标系、单位、动作限制、相机标定和时间戳。策略请求的指令，可能不同于经过裁剪、插值或控制器覆盖后实际施加的指令。用错了其中一个，就会教给模型错误的动作与结果关系。对于纯视频数据，应明确记录缺少校准机器人动作，而不是悄悄编造动作。
text.en: A useful robot transition record contains synchronized observations, the executed command, its duration, and relevant robot state. Keep coordinate frames, units, action limits, camera calibration, and timestamps with the data. The command requested by a policy may differ from the command applied after clipping, interpolation, or a controller override. Training on the wrong one teaches the model a misleading action-to-outcome relationship. For video-only data, explicitly record that calibrated robot actions are unavailable rather than silently inventing them.

title.zh: 真值取决于你问的问题
title.en: Ground truth depends on the question

text.zh: 记录的下一张相机图像，可以作为该传感器观测的预测目标，其中也包含噪声与遮挡。它并不自动成为所有隐藏物理变量的真值。物体位姿可能需要标定跟踪，接触可能需要合适的测量或标注，任务成功则需要明确的事件定义。仿真可以提供物理相机无法直接观察的状态与接触变量。应把这些额外真值标签，与部署控制器能够获得的信息分开。
text.en: The next recorded camera frame is a target for predicting that sensor observation, including its noise and occlusions. It is not automatically ground truth for every hidden physical variable. Object pose may require calibrated tracking, contact may require suitable measurements or annotations, and task success needs an explicit event definition. Simulation can expose state and contact variables that a physical camera cannot directly observe. Keep those privileged labels separate from the information available to the deployed controller.

title.zh: 一条记录，不包含所有反事实
title.en: One recorded future is not every counterfactual

text.zh: 一条转移记录告诉我们，实际执行某个动作之后发生了什么。它并不会揭示，同一场景在所有其他指令下会怎样发展。反事实评估需要额外干预、可重复重置，或经过独立验证的仿真器，并明确各自假设。真实重置并不完美，摩擦、抓握位置与物体速度可能在试验间变化。应重复测试条件并报告变化，而不是把单次替代预测写成已验证的物理真相。
text.en: A logged transition tells us what followed the action that was actually executed. It does not reveal what the same scene would have done under every alternative command. Counterfactual evaluation needs additional interventions, repeatable resets, or a separately validated simulator, with their assumptions made explicit. Real resets are imperfect: friction, grasp position, and object velocity may change between trials. Use repeated conditions and report that variability instead of presenting a single alternative prediction as verified physical truth.

title.zh: 测试泛化之前，先分好数据
title.en: Split episodes before testing generalization

text.zh: 按完整轨迹划分数据，并围绕真正关心的泛化问题划分。同一录像中随机抽取的相邻帧，可能让训练集与测试集几乎相同。在杯子例子中，应区分熟悉场景与新物体、新相机位置、新光照及新动作范围。让验证阶段的选择与最终保留测试分开，并披露是否在目标配置上进行适配。泛化描述的是训练分布与测试分布的关系，而不是一次精彩演示就能确立的性质。
text.en: Split data by complete trajectories and by the generalization question you actually care about. Random neighboring frames from one recording can make train and test sets nearly identical. For the cup example, separate familiar scenes from new objects, camera positions, lighting, and action ranges. Keep validation decisions separate from the final held-out test, and disclose any adaptation on the target setup. Generalization is a relationship between training and test distributions, not a property established by one impressive demonstration.

text.zh: 一种表示可以在自己的训练目标上进步，却没有改善最初希望解决的任务。第一版 Dreamer 通过最终控制器的表现比较表示目标，原图展示的就是这种实验。结果属于其架构与任务，并不证明重建在所有情况下都必要。比较潜在模型时，不应仅凭正在优化的同一编码器所测距离就宣布胜出。在应用允许时，应补充独立物理测量或下游指标。

That result belongs to its architecture and tasks; it does not prove reconstruction is always necessary. When comparing latent models, avoid declaring victory only on a distance measured by the same learned encoder being optimized. Add independent physical or downstream measurements wherever the application permits.

title.zh: 在多个时域测试递推预测

text.zh: 固定上下文窗口，标明观测停止的位置，再使用记录的未来动作向前预测。在各个预测时域，把预测与保留观测或可用状态标签比较。不要每一步悄悄重新输入真实下一帧，却把它叫作长期开环推演。Dreamer 的原预测图区分了上下文帧与模型生成的未来帧。除了平均误差，还应报告接触变化附近的错误，因为短暂而关键的失败可能淹没在长段简单序列里。

The original Dreamer prediction figure distinguishes context frames from model-generated future frames. Report errors around contact changes as well as averages, because a short critical failure can disappear inside a long easy sequence.

title.zh: 不确定性需要分布层面的测试
title.en: Uncertainty needs a distributional test

text.zh: 只观察到一个未来，并不能说明模型预测的所有其他未来都不可能。应使用适合其输出的指标评估概率模型，例如有意义的似然，或保留重复结果中的覆盖率。很宽的区间可能覆盖许多结果，却缺少有用精度，因此也应报告区间宽度。交互式线性系统例子拥有已知噪声模型与解析参考分布。其中显示的覆盖率是教学结果，并不是 Dreamer 或物理机器人的校准证据。
text.en: A single observed future cannot tell us whether every other predicted future was impossible. Evaluate a probabilistic model with measures appropriate to its output, such as likelihoods when meaningful or coverage over held-out repeated outcomes. Wide intervals can cover many outcomes while providing little useful precision, so report their width as well. Our interactive linear-system example has a known noise model and an analytical reference distribution. Its displayed coverage is a teaching result, not calibration evidence for Dreamer or a physical robot.

text.zh: 像素误差、感知距离与视频分布分数，描述生成观测的不同方面。它们并不直接测量杯子是否被正确抓住、运送、放置并释放。反过来，任务导向模型即使从不生成精细图像，也可能支持有效控制。TD-MPC2 的独立视觉控制图，测量十个图像输入仿真任务的回合回报，而不是照片真实感分数。每一个报告数值，都应附带指标名称、输入类型、环境，以及试验预算。
text.en: Pixel errors, perceptual distances, and video-distribution scores describe aspects of generated observations. They do not directly measure whether the cup was grasped, transported, placed, and released correctly. Conversely, a task-oriented model may support useful control without ever generating a detailed image. TD-MPC2's separate visual-control figure measures episode return on ten image-based simulation tasks, rather than a photorealism score. Keep the metric name, input type, environment, and trial budget attached to every reported number.

title.zh: 把成功定义覆盖完整事件
title.en: Define success over the complete event

text.zh: 对于拟议的杯子转移基准，应在运行方法之前定义过程：抓握、抬起、运送、放置、释放，并保持稳定。应规定容差与观察时长，而不是看到结果后再修改。短暂抬起不能算完整放置，人工救援也应保留在记录中。DayDreamer 的机械臂图报告了自己的每分钟物体数指标，说明实际成功与吞吐定义为何重要。
text.en: For a proposed cup-transfer benchmark, define the sequence before running any method: grasp, lift, transport, place, release, and remain stable. Specify the required tolerances and observation period instead of changing them after seeing results. A brief lift does not count as complete placement, and a human rescue should remain visible in the record. DayDreamer's arm figure reports its own objects-per-minute task measure, which illustrates why the actual success and throughput definitions matter.

title.zh: 公平比较信息与计算资源
title.en: Compare information and computation fairly

text.zh: 比较架构之前，先匹配观测、动作空间、控制频率、可用数据与任务定义。把训练计算与决策计算分开报告，包括候选数量、规划迭代次数，以及端到端延迟。基于仿真状态的基线，与只用相机的物理控制器接收的信息不同。只要明确标为使用额外信息，真值状态基线仍然可以提供参考。V-JEPA 2-AC 报告的规划延迟说明，推理硬件与搜索设置应放在任务结果旁，而不是被省略的脚注里。
text.en: Match observations, action space, control rate, data access, and task definitions before comparing architectures. Report training compute separately from decision-time compute, including candidate counts, planning iterations, and end-to-end latency. A state-based simulator baseline receives different information from a camera-only physical controller. An oracle-state baseline can still be informative if it is clearly labeled as privileged. V-JEPA 2-AC's reported planning latency shows why inference hardware and search settings belong beside task results rather than in an omitted footnote.

title.zh: 建立能回答问题的基线阶梯
title.en: Build a baseline ladder that answers questions

text.zh: 预测测试先从简单基线开始：重复最新观测、外推测得的运动，并在有意义时移除动作条件。它们揭示模型是否真正利用动作与历史，而不是利用数据大部分静止的特点。控制方面，比较同一策略有无模型辅助，再逐项改变组件。尽量匹配预算，并明确报告剩余差异。消融的价值在于隔离问题，而不是多加几行结果就自动让评估严谨。
text.en: Start prediction tests with simple baselines: repeat the latest observation, extrapolate measured motion, and remove action conditioning where that ablation is meaningful. These reveal whether the learned model uses actions and history rather than exploiting a mostly static dataset. For control, compare the same policy with and without model assistance, then vary one component at a time. Use matched budgets where possible and explicitly report remaining differences. An ablation is useful because it isolates a question, not because adding more rows automatically makes the evaluation rigorous.

title.zh: 让失败留在分母里
title.en: Keep failures in the denominator

text.zh: 保存每次试验编号、初始条件、动作轨迹、预测轨迹、结果与干预原因。区分感知失败、动力学错误、任务评分误导、求解延迟，以及控制执行错误。只收录成功视频，会删掉理解可靠性最需要的案例。报告完整试验、剔除理由、种子或条件间变化，以及与样本量相符的不确定性。对于生成训练数据，也应保留筛选规则和被拒样本，因为筛选会改变最终策略所学的数据分布。
text.en: Save every trial identifier, initial condition, action trace, prediction trace, outcome, and intervention reason. Separate perception failures, wrong dynamics, misleading task scores, solver delays, and controller execution errors. A successful-only video collection removes the very cases needed to understand reliability. Report completed trials, exclusions with reasons, variation across seeds or conditions, and uncertainty appropriate to the sample size. For generated training data, preserve the filtering rule and rejected examples too, because selection changes the distribution that the final policy learns from.

title.zh: 有用的模型，要在闭环里证明价值
title.en: A useful model earns its place in the loop

text.zh: 不存在一个可以跨无关任务，把视频生成器、潜在规划器与想象训练策略合并比较的统一排名。最先进结果的说法，只有放在明确数据集、输入接口、预算、指标与评估过程里才有意义。对自己的机器人，应从最简单且可测量的基线开始，找出关键失败，再在能够改善它的位置加入世界模型。然后测试完整闭环，也包括预测错误的情况。
text.en: There is no single ranking that combines a video generator, a latent planner, and a policy trained in imagination across unrelated tasks. State-of-the-art claims only make sense inside a specified dataset, input interface, budget, metric, and evaluation procedure. For your robot, begin with the simplest measurable baseline, identify the failure that matters, and add a world model where it can address that failure. Then test the complete loop, including the cases where its predictions are wrong.

description.zh: 从像素学习隐状态动力学，减少视觉连续控制所需的真实环境交互。
description.en: Learn hidden dynamics from pixels to reduce environment interaction for visual continuous control.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：PMLR 97, ICML 2019, pp.2555–2565；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to PMLR 97, ICML 2019, pp.2555–2565; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 当前及历史64×64 RGB图像、历史连续动作；训练回放另含实际奖励。没有任务文字输入。
text.en: Current/history 64×64 RGB images and past continuous actions; replay also contains observed rewards. There is no language-command input.

text.zh: 模型输出隐状态转移、奖励预测和用于训练的图像重建；CEM输出当前要执行的连续动作。
text.en: The model predicts latent transitions, rewards and training-time image reconstructions; CEM selects the current continuous control action.

text.zh: RSSM以确定性循环记忆保存历史，并以连续随机状态表示剩余不确定性；观测更新后验，想象使用先验。
text.en: An RSSM combines deterministic recurrent memory and continuous stochastic state. Observations update the posterior; imagined transitions use the prior.

text.zh: 图像编码器、RSSM转移、图像解码器和奖励头；标准PlaNet没有独立策略网络或价值网络。
text.en: An image encoder, RSSM transition, image decoder and reward head; standard PlaNet has neither a learned actor nor a value network.

text.zh: 从随机动作种子轨迹开始，交替更新世界模型和采集新轨迹。论文提出多步latent overshooting，但明确最终RSSM代理不依赖该项；不能把它写成必需组件。
text.en: Start from random seed episodes, then alternate model learning and collection. The paper introduces multi-step latent overshooting but explicitly states the final RSSM agent does not require it.

text.zh: 环境交互给出图像、动作、奖励；变分目标含重建/奖励似然与先验后验KL。不是只读无动作网络视频。
text.en: Interaction supplies observations, actions and rewards. Variational training combines observation/reward likelihoods with prior/posterior KL, rather than learning from action-free web video.

text.zh: 在线CEM：采样动作序列，用隐空间奖励之和评估，拟合优选序列分布；只执行第一步并重新观测。
text.en: Online CEM samples action sequences, scores imagined reward sums, refits the elite distribution, executes the first action and observes again.

text.zh: 新画面更新当前隐状态后，每个决策步重新规划。规划时不解码图像；动作重复设置影响决策步与环境步的对应。
text.en: Each observation updates the latent belief before replanning. Planning does not decode images. Action repetition distinguishes decision steps from environment frames.

text.zh: 六项DeepMind Control Suite仿真视觉连续控制，统一64×64第三人称图像；不是真机机器人试验。原文比较有不同观测与数据预算，不能把其比值迁移成通用排序。
text.en: Six simulated DeepMind Control Suite visual-control tasks use third-person 64×64 images. These are not physical-robot experiments; original comparisons differ in observations and data budgets.

text.zh: 规划受模型误差、搜索预算与有限时域限制；图像重建虽有丰富监督，也可能花容量刻画与奖励无关细节。
text.en: Model error, search budget and finite horizon constrain planning; reconstruction can allocate capacity to details irrelevant to reward.

title.zh: DreamerV1
title.en: DreamerV1

description.zh: 如何把模型中的短时想象变成能处理长时回报的策略，避免每次动作都在线搜索？
description.en: How can short imagined rollouts train long-horizon behavior without performing online search for every action?

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：1912.01603v3；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to 1912.01603v3; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 主要实验是64×64视觉观测与过去动作；训练需要环境奖励。当前模型状态综合历史信息。
text.en: Main experiments use 64×64 visual observations and past actions; training requires environment rewards. The current model state summarizes history.

text.zh: 世界模型给未来隐状态和奖励；actor给连续动作分布，critic给累计回报估计。
text.en: The world model predicts latent states and rewards, the actor an action distribution, and the critic accumulated return.

text.zh: 连续随机潜变量加确定性循环记忆的RSSM，延续PlaNet的表示结构。
text.en: An RSSM with continuous stochastic variables and deterministic recurrent memory follows the PlaNet representation.

text.zh: 编码器/RSSM/重建与奖励头，加独立actor和critic。预测图像用于训练，不必在想象中逐帧解码。
text.en: Encoder, RSSM, reconstruction/reward heads, plus separate actor and critic. Image reconstruction shapes training; latent imagination need not decode every frame.

text.zh: 交替模型学习、想象行为学习和环境采样。连续动作使用可微动力学传播价值梯度，critic的λ-return将有限想象连接到更长回报。
text.en: Alternate model learning, imagined behavior learning and collection. For continuous control, value gradients propagate through differentiable dynamics; critic λ-returns bootstrap beyond finite imagination.

text.zh: 回放中的图像、动作和奖励监督模型；actor和critic由模型预测的奖励与隐状态训练。评估了重建、对比与仅奖励表示目标。
text.en: Replay images, actions and rewards supervise the model; imagined latent states and predicted rewards train actor/critic. Reconstruction, contrastive and reward-only objectives are compared.

text.zh: 把规划工作摊到策略训练：执行时使用训练好的actor，不是对每一步运行PlaNet式CEM。
text.en: Planning is amortized into behavior learning: execution uses the trained actor rather than PlaNet-style CEM at each step.

text.zh: 编码新观测以更新模型状态，actor直接提出下一动作；交互经验继续进入回放。
text.en: Encode the new observation, update model state and query the actor directly; interaction continues to populate replay.

text.zh: 20项DeepMind Control Suite视觉控制仿真；该版本重点是连续控制和表示目标消融，不能套用后续Atari或真实机器人结论。
text.en: Twenty visual DeepMind Control Suite tasks, emphasizing continuous control and representation ablations. Later Atari or physical-robot results do not belong to this version.

text.zh: 策略可能利用世界模型的错误；需要任务奖励和持续交互。会想象不代表已具备语言理解或真实机器人零样本泛化。
text.en: The actor can exploit model error and still needs task rewards and interaction. Imagination does not imply language understanding or zero-shot physical-robot generalization.

description.zh: 让可单独训练的世界模型提供足够好的想象经验，学习Atari等复杂视觉行为。
description.en: Make a separately learned world model useful enough for imagined behavior learning in complex visual games such as Atari.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：2010.02193v4；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to 2010.02193v4; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 主Atari设置使用缩放为64×64的图像与动作历史；训练回放含奖励及终止折扣。RSSM记忆替代输入帧堆叠。
text.en: The main Atari setup uses images resized to 64×64 and past actions; replay includes rewards and terminal discounts. RSSM memory replaces input-frame stacking.

text.zh: 先验/后验类别状态、图像重建、奖励与折扣预测；actor输出离散动作分布，也支持连续任务。
text.en: Categorical prior/posterior states, image reconstructions, rewards and discounts; the actor outputs discrete actions and also supports continuous tasks.

text.zh: 将V1的高斯随机状态改成多个类别变量，默认32个变量、每个32类；配合确定性GRU记忆。离散状态不是自然语言token。
text.en: Replace V1 Gaussian states with multiple categoricals, by default 32 variables with 32 classes, alongside deterministic GRU memory. These are not language tokens.

text.zh: CNN、离散RSSM、图像/奖励/折扣头和actor-critic。采样采用straight-through梯度，KL balancing分配先验学习与后验正则力度。
text.en: CNN, discrete RSSM, image/reward/discount heads and actor/critic. Straight-through gradients handle samples; KL balancing separates prior fitting and posterior regularization.

text.zh: Atari离散控制偏向REINFORCE梯度；连续控制可使用动力学梯度。类别潜状态与平衡KL是重要改动，但版本差异还包括其它优化，不能仅归因单一技巧。
text.en: Atari favors REINFORCE actor gradients; continuous control can use dynamics gradients. Categorical latents and balanced KL matter, alongside additional implementation changes.

text.zh: 世界模型从真实交互序列学习，不接受actor梯度来改写预测；actor/critic从固定模型想象序列更新。
text.en: Real interaction sequences train the world model; actor gradients do not rewrite its predictions. Actor/critic updates use imagined sequences under the learned model.

text.zh: 想象训练actor；实际动作由actor直接采样，不在环境每一步运行树搜索或CEM。
text.en: Train the actor in imagination; sample real actions directly from it without per-step tree search or CEM.

text.zh: 当前图像更新后验隐状态，actor输出环境动作；模型记忆跨时间整合信息。
text.en: The current image updates the posterior model state; the actor produces an action while recurrent memory integrates temporal information.

text.zh: 固定v4主实验为55款Atari、sticky actions、每游戏独立代理、2亿Atari环境帧预算（文中称environment steps）、动作重复4；另有连续控制。与MuZero原版确定性Atari不能直接横排。
text.en: Pinned v4 studies 55 Atari games with sticky actions, a separate agent per game, a 200-million Atari-frame budget (called environment steps in the text) and action repeat four, plus continuous control. Original MuZero deterministic Atari differs.

text.zh: 离散表示不自动消除模型偏差；世界模型重建质量和行为成绩是不同测量。主结果是游戏/仿真，不是真机证据。
text.en: Discrete representations do not remove model bias. Reconstruction quality and behavior scores remain different measurements; main evidence is games/simulation rather than physical robots.

description.zh: 让同一套超参数适应图像/向量观测、离散/连续动作及不同奖励尺度。
description.en: Use one hyperparameter configuration across image/vector inputs, discrete/continuous actions and varying reward scales.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：2301.04104v2；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to 2301.04104v2; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 按任务提供图像或向量观测及动作历史；训练序列另含奖励与继续标志。不是通用语言指令接口。
text.en: Task-specific image or vector observations and action history; training additionally uses rewards and continuation flags. This is not a general language-command interface.

text.zh: RSSM隐状态、重建、奖励与继续概率；actor输出任务动作，critic给回报分布。
text.en: RSSM states, reconstructions, rewards and continuation probabilities; actor actions and critic return distributions.

text.zh: 类别随机状态与确定性循环记忆；CNN处理图像，MLP处理向量。状态用于行为，不需要在部署时生成视频。
text.en: Categorical stochastic state and deterministic recurrence, with CNN image and MLP vector processing. Behavior uses latent states without deployment-time video generation.

text.zh: RSSM、预测头、actor/critic；固定v2包含symlog变换、平衡动力学/表示KL、free bits、少量均匀混合与回报尺度归一化。
text.en: RSSM, prediction heads, actor/critic; pinned v2 includes symlog transforms, balanced dynamics/representation KL, free bits, a small uniform mixture and return-scale normalization.

text.zh: 回放训练模型，再从后验起点滚动先验，训练actor-critic；稳定化使不同尺度下的损失与策略熵可共用配置。
text.en: Fit the model from replay, roll out priors from posterior start states, and train actor/critic. Stabilization balances losses and policy entropy across scales.

text.zh: 来自环境的观测、动作、奖励、继续标志监督世界模型；想象奖励与价值自举监督行为。无人工演示不等于无奖励。
text.en: Observed inputs, actions, rewards and continuation labels supervise the model; imagined rewards and bootstrapped values train behavior. No demonstrations does not mean no rewards.

text.zh: 原文明确环境交互采样actor，没有前视搜索；想象发生于策略学习阶段。
text.en: The paper explicitly samples the actor for interaction without lookahead search; imagination is used during behavior learning.

text.zh: 观测更新模型状态后直接采样动作；单一配置指训练配方，不是一个共享权重代理同时精通所有任务。
text.en: Update model state and sample the action directly. A single configuration means a common training recipe, not one shared-weight agent mastering every task simultaneously.

text.zh: 本记录固定2024年4月arXiv v2，覆盖150多任务和Minecraft从零收集钻石等游戏结果；不能混入后来的Nature修订、更多任务数量或成功率。
text.en: This record fixes April 2024 arXiv v2: over 150 tasks and Minecraft diamond collection from scratch, among game results. Later Nature revisions, task counts and success rates are excluded.

text.zh: 模型仍依赖交互数据覆盖和任务奖励；跨领域固定配置不等于未知机器人的零样本转移，也不是接触物理准确性证明。
text.en: Performance still depends on data coverage and task rewards; a fixed cross-domain recipe is neither zero-shot transfer to unseen robots nor proof of contact-physics accuracy.

title.zh: DayDreamer
title.en: DayDreamer

description.zh: 验证Dreamer能否在真实硬件上边交互边学习，不先训练模拟器或使用演示。
description.en: Test whether Dreamer can learn online on physical hardware without simulator pretraining or demonstrations.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：PMLR 205, CoRL 2022 proceedings published 2023, pp.2226–2240；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to PMLR 205, CoRL 2022 proceedings published 2023, pp.2226–2240; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 平台相关观测：A1用关节与姿态/角速度；机械臂用RGB、关节等，XArm加入深度；Sphero用画面历史。训练包含任务奖励。
text.en: Platform-specific inputs: A1 joint/orientation/angular-velocity sensing; arms combine RGB and proprioception, with depth for XArm; Sphero uses image history. Training includes task rewards.

text.zh: actor给平台动作；A1为关节目标角，UR5/XArm为离散末端增量接口，Sphero为连续控制。不能把各平台当同一控制空间。
text.en: Actor outputs match the platform: A1 target joint angles, discrete end-effector increments for UR5/XArm and continuous Sphero controls. They are different action interfaces.

text.zh: DreamerV2式离散RSSM融合传感器观测，循环状态记忆遮挡与朝向信息；解码器重建用于训练。
text.en: DreamerV2-style discrete RSSM fuses sensors and retains temporal information about occlusion/orientation; decoder reconstruction supports training.

text.zh: 世界模型与actor-critic；异步actor线程操控硬件、learner线程训练，约每20秒同步策略权重。
text.en: World model and actor/critic with asynchronous threads: the actor controls hardware, the learner trains, and policy weights synchronize roughly every 20 seconds.

text.zh: 回放训练世界模型，在有限步隐空间想象中更新actor/critic；学习与采集并行。连续动作可用重参数化梯度，离散动作用REINFORCE。
text.en: Fit the model from replay and update actor/critic through finite-horizon latent imagination while collection runs in parallel. Continuous actions use reparameterization; discrete actions use REINFORCE.

text.zh: 真实硬件交互产生观测、动作和人为定义的奖励。任务包含稀疏或稠密奖励；A1有奖励课程及动作过滤，不是没有工程约束。
text.en: Physical interaction supplies observations, actions and engineered rewards. Tasks use sparse or dense rewards; A1 includes a reward curriculum and action filtering.

text.zh: 实际控制是运行actor，不是每步做模型搜索。论文“想象规划”主要指训练行为。
text.en: Real control runs the actor rather than per-step model search; imagined planning primarily refers to behavior training.

text.zh: 控制频率随平台变：A1 20Hz、UR5 2Hz、XArm约0.5Hz、Sphero2Hz。硬件PD/动作过滤与策略计算属于不同层。
text.en: Rates depend on platform: A1 20 Hz, UR5 2 Hz, XArm roughly 0.5 Hz and Sphero 2 Hz. Hardware PD/filtering differs from policy computation.

text.zh: 四种真机、四类具体任务；A1从翻身、站立到行走约1小时，机械臂视觉抓放和Sphero导航另有各自协议。A1无需姿态重置，但到场地边缘仍有人移动位置。
text.en: Four real platforms and specific tasks; A1 learns recovery/standing/walking in about one hour, with separate visual arm and navigation protocols. A1 avoids posture resets but humans reposition it at area boundaries.

text.zh: 奖励、动作接口、人工边界处理与硬件磨损不能省略；并未验证任意灵巧手精细操作，也不能把一小时推广到所有机器人。
text.en: Rewards, action interfaces, boundary intervention and hardware wear remain relevant. This does not establish arbitrary dexterous-hand manipulation or one-hour learning for every robot.

title.zh: TD-MPC
title.en: TD-MPC

description.zh: 用短期模型规划与长期价值估计结合，避免完全重建世界或仅靠短时域搜索。
description.en: Combine short model rollouts with learned long-term value, without reconstructing the full world or relying only on a short horizon.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：2203.04955v2；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to 2203.04955v2; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 按实验使用低维状态、图像或多模态观测，另有连续动作和奖励；部分任务提供目标条件。
text.en: Experiment-dependent state, image or multimodal observations, continuous actions and rewards; some tasks include goal conditioning.

text.zh: 编码状态、预测下一潜状态、即时奖励、末端Q值和策略动作；规划器输出当前连续动作。
text.en: Encode state and predict next latent state, immediate reward, terminal Q-value and policy actions; the planner chooses a continuous action.

text.zh: 任务导向潜动力学TOLD：只需保留对控制与回报有用的信息，没有图像重建解码器。
text.en: Task-Oriented Latent Dynamics, TOLD, retains control/return-relevant information without an image-reconstruction decoder.

text.zh: 五组件h编码、d动力学、R奖励、Q价值、π策略；隐空间一致性与奖励和TD值联合优化。
text.en: Five components: encoder h, dynamics d, reward R, value Q and policy π, jointly optimized with latent consistency, reward and TD-value losses.

text.zh: 从回放抽取短序列展开模型，更新奖励、价值、潜一致性；策略通过Q学习产生高值候选，动作梯度不必训练一个通用视觉生成器。
text.en: Unroll short replay sequences to learn rewards, values and latent consistency; a Q-trained policy proposes high-value candidates without training a general visual generator.

text.zh: 真实环境转移及奖励提供监督；下一观测的目标编码器表示作为潜状态目标，价值用TD自举。无解码器不等于无训练标签。
text.en: Observed transitions/rewards supervise learning, a target encoder provides next-latent targets, and TD bootstraps value. Decoder-free does not mean unsupervised.

text.zh: 在线采样轨迹优化：短期奖励和＋折扣末端Q。候选混合采样分布与策略轨迹，优选加权更新；每次执行首步并重规划。
text.en: Online sampled trajectory optimization combines short reward sums and discounted terminal Q, mixing distribution samples with policy rollouts, reweighting elites and executing only the first action.

text.zh: 默认仍规划，前一步解热启动下一步；可单用策略加速，但这是性能/计算折中，不能把它当主实验默认。
text.en: Default execution still plans and warm-starts from the previous solution. Actor-only execution is a speed/performance tradeoff, not the main default.

text.zh: 仿真连续控制：DMControl状态/像素、Meta-World等；分别报告return、数据量和动作重复。原版不是物理机器人发布验证。
text.en: Simulated continuous control includes state/pixel DMControl and Meta-World, with protocol-specific returns, budgets and action repeats. The original is not a physical deployment validation.

text.zh: 潜表示面向所学奖励，换任务未必保留全部信息；有限搜索与模型误差仍存在。连续动作设置不能直接套用MuZero离散树搜索成绩。
text.en: Reward-focused latents may omit information needed for a new task; search limits and model error remain. Continuous-control results do not directly compare with MuZero’s discrete search.

title.zh: TD-MPC2 (arXiv v2)
title.en: TD-MPC2 (arXiv v2)

description.zh: 让TD-MPC跨不同任务尺度、形态和动作维数稳定训练，并能扩展到多任务模型。
description.en: Make TD-MPC robust to task scales, embodiments and action dimensions, including larger multitask models.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：2310.16828v2；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to 2310.16828v2; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 主要实验为状态观测、连续动作、任务嵌入；像素版本另用CNN。多任务输入输出补零并屏蔽无效动作维。
text.en: Main experiments use state observations, continuous actions and task embeddings; the visual variant adds a CNN. Multitask inputs/outputs are padded and invalid action dimensions masked.

text.zh: 潜状态、奖励/价值分布、随机策略先验；在线MPPI产生实际连续动作。
text.en: Latent states, reward/value distributions and a stochastic policy prior; online MPPI selects the actual continuous action.

text.zh: 无解码器的控制导向潜状态，SimNorm把连续向量分组成softmax单纯形；不是Dreamer式随机类别采样。
text.en: Decoder-free control-centric latents; SimNorm groups a continuous vector into softmax simplices, rather than Dreamer-style stochastic categorical samples.

text.zh: 编码/动力学/奖励/Q/策略五组件；LayerNorm、Mish、SimNorm，默认5个Q网络及目标网络。多任务各组件接受可学习任务嵌入。
text.en: Five encoder/dynamics/reward/Q/policy components with LayerNorm, Mish and SimNorm; default five Q networks with target copies. Multitask components receive learned task embeddings.

text.zh: 单任务在线交互与回放更新；大规模80任务模型另用240个单任务代理回放合计5.45亿转移离线训练。不能把它称互联网视频预训练。
text.en: Single-task online interaction alternates with replay updates. The 80-task models instead train offline on 545 million replay transitions from 240 single-task agents, not internet video.

text.zh: 转移奖励、潜表示一致性和TD目标；奖励/价值使用对数变换空间中的分布回归，策略有最大熵目标。
text.en: Transition rewards, latent consistency and TD targets supervise learning; reward/value use distributional regression in log-transformed space, with a maximum-entropy policy objective.

text.zh: 部署时MPPI在线轨迹搜索，策略先验提供一部分候选；短期奖励加末端价值，执行第一动作、观测后重规划。
text.en: Deployment uses online MPPI trajectory search with policy-seeded candidates, short-horizon rewards and terminal value; execute the first action and replan after observing.

text.zh: 任务嵌入和观测确定潜状态，屏蔽无效动作维，热启动优化。模型规模增大不代表控制频率保持不变。
text.en: Observation and task embedding determine latent state, invalid action dimensions are masked, and optimization is warm-started. Larger model size does not guarantee unchanged control rate.

text.zh: 104项仿真连续控制、单任务同超参数；80任务317M模型是另一个规模化设置；10项像素DMControl也是单独实验。三组不能混称全像素单模型104任务。
text.en: There are 104 simulated continuous-control tasks with shared hyperparameters, a separate 80-task 317M scaling setup, and ten visual DMControl tasks. These are not one pixel-based 104-task model.

text.zh: 该版本面向连续动作，离散动作扩展留待后续；仍依赖任务奖励和大数据预算。无解码器不意味着预测所有接触物理准确。
text.en: This version targets continuous actions and leaves discrete-action extension open. It still requires rewards and data, and decoder-free modeling does not establish accurate contact physics.
