title.zh: MuZero (arXiv v2)
title.en: MuZero (arXiv v2)

description.zh: 不把已知转移规则写入搜索，而学习足以预测奖励、价值、策略的隐模型进行搜索。
description.en: Learn a search model sufficient for rewards, values and policies instead of supplying transition rules to the search procedure.

version.zh: 本记录固定来源：1911.08265v2；不混入后续版本。
version.en: This record is pinned to 1911.08265v2; later revisions are excluded.

text.zh: 表征函数接收观测历史；Atari具体为最近32张96×96 RGB帧及对应动作，棋类使用棋盘编码。环境仍提供实际奖励和根节点合法动作。
text.en: The representation receives observation history: Atari uses the last 32 RGB frames at 96×96 and their actions; board games use board encodings. The environment supplies rewards and root legal actions.

text.zh: 隐状态、一步奖励、策略先验、状态价值；MCTS给改进后的动作访问分布，用其选实际动作。
text.en: Hidden state, one-step reward, policy prior and state value; MCTS produces an improved visit distribution for selecting the actual move.

text.zh: 隐状态只承担预测搜索所需量的职责，不要求重建像素或与真实物理状态一一对应；本版本动力学是确定性的。
text.en: Hidden states support search-relevant predictions without pixel reconstruction or one-to-one physical semantics. Dynamics are deterministic in this version.

text.zh: h表征过去观测；g将隐状态与动作映射为下一隐状态和奖励；f预测策略与价值。三者联合训练。
text.en: Representation h encodes history; dynamics g maps hidden state/action to next hidden state and reward; prediction f produces policy and value. All train jointly.

text.zh: 从回放轨迹取样，递归展开模型并匹配多步奖励/价值/策略目标；不断搜索采样新轨迹。Reanalyze是另一个明确区分的回放再搜索变体。
text.en: Sample replay, recurrently unroll the model and match multi-step reward/value/policy targets while search collects more experience. Reanalyze is a separately identified replay-research variant.

text.zh: 奖励目标来自环境，价值目标来自实际回报或自举，策略目标来自MCTS访问分布。隐藏状态无需真实状态标签，但不是没有奖励/搜索监督。
text.en: Rewards come from the environment, values from realized or bootstrapped returns, and policy targets from MCTS visits. Hidden states need no ground-truth state labels, but rewards/search provide supervision.

text.zh: 环境每个决策点运行MCTS，用策略先验扩展、价值评估叶节点、奖励回传；不是Dreamer式单actor直接执行。
text.en: Run MCTS at decision points using policy priors, leaf values and backed-up rewards, rather than a Dreamer-style actor-only decision.

text.zh: 观测历史编码根状态，模型在树内模拟动作后果，然后选动作、获得新观测。根节点合法动作由环境给出；树内不调用真实转移模拟器。
text.en: Encode the root from history, simulate consequences within the tree, select an action and observe again. Root legal actions come from the environment; internal search does not call the true transition simulator.

text.zh: 棋类Go/Chess/Shogi与57款Atari，原文分别用800与50次搜索模拟；Atari原版为确定性环境口径，与DreamerV2的sticky actions不同，也不是真机遥操作证据。
text.en: Go/chess/shogi and 57 Atari games use 800 and 50 search simulations respectively. Original Atari is deterministic, unlike DreamerV2 sticky actions, and provides no physical teleoperation evidence.

text.zh: 有限离散动作集合与大量搜索计算；价值相关隐状态未必支持图像生成或任意新奖励。不能把“无需转移规则”扩大成完全不知道动作集合与接口。
text.en: Discrete action sets and substantial search compute limit scope. Value-relevant latents need not support image generation or arbitrary new rewards. No transition rules does not mean unknown action sets/interfaces.

description.zh: 不必逐像素画出未来，也能预测任务相关状态并选择机器人动作吗？
description.en: Can task-relevant future features support robot action selection without rendering future pixels?

text.zh: 视频观测；AC加入末端位姿、夹爪状态与动作差；规划还接收目标图像。
text.en: Video observations; AC adds end-effector pose, gripper state, and action differences; planning also receives a goal image.

text.zh: 预测视觉特征；外部 CEM 规划器选择校准机器人动作。
text.en: Predicted visual features; an external CEM planner chooses calibrated robot actions.

text.zh: 编码器把图像映射为特征网格。基础 V-JEPA 2 做遮挡特征预测；AC 预测器额外接收动作和末端状态，预测下一帧特征。
text.en: An encoder maps images to feature grids. Base V-JEPA 2 predicts masked features; the AC predictor adds actions and end-effector states to predict next-frame features.

text.zh: 先用超过100万小时视频预训练表示，再冻结编码器，用 DROID 子集不足62小时、256×256/4fps片段训练约300M动作预测器。无标签指没有任务/奖励/成败标签，仍有末端位姿及夹爪信号；相邻7维状态差构成动作。教师强制损失加两步滚动损失。
text.en: Pretrain features on over one million video hours, freeze the encoder, then fit a roughly 300M action predictor on under 62 hours of DROID clips at 256×256 and 4 fps. Unlabeled means no task, reward or success labels; end-effector pose and gripper signals remain available. Actions are differences of seven-dimensional states. Training combines teacher forcing and a two-step rollout loss.

text.zh: 当前图像和目标图像分别编码。CEM采样候选动作序列，以预测终点特征到目标特征的L1距离筛选。执行第一步，重新观察，再规划。取放提供多个图像子目标。
text.en: Encode current and goal images. CEM searches action sequences using L1 distance from predicted terminal features to goal features. Execute the first action, observe again and replan. Pick-and-place uses multiple image subgoals.

text.zh: 两间实验室的Franka+RobotiQ真机；每种技能/物体/实验室10次试验。Table 3 的特定设置使用单RTX4090，800样本×10轮、horizon=1，16秒规划一个动作。
text.en: Real Franka arms with RobotiQ grippers in two labs; ten trials per evaluated skill/object/lab. Table 3 uses one RTX 4090, 800 samples × 10 refinements, horizon one, and 16 seconds to plan one action.

text.zh: 零样本是未加入目标实验室的机器人训练数据，不是没看过机器人数据。相机位置要人工选择；长时域误差累积；图像子目标仍来自外部。论文里的旧Cosmos对比不能泛化成所有像素模型更慢或更差。
text.en: Zero-shot excludes training on the target labs, not prior robot data. Camera placement was selected manually; long horizons accumulate error; image subgoals are externally provided. The paper’s old Cosmos comparison does not establish a universal ranking of pixel models.

description.zh: 只有视频、没有操作者动作标签，怎样学出可按键控制的环境？
description.en: How can video-only data produce an environment that responds to controls?

text.zh: 过去视频帧与选定的学习离散潜在动作码。
text.en: Past video frames and a selected learned discrete latent-action code.

text.zh: 动作条件未来视频帧；学习动作码不是校准电机指令。
text.en: Action-conditioned future video frames; the learned code is not a calibrated motor command.

text.zh: 三部分：视频tokenizer、潜动作模型LAM、动力学模型。LAM从相邻视觉变化压缩出离散潜动作；它不是天然带有真实机器人单位的控制命令。
text.en: Three parts: a video tokenizer, latent-action model and dynamics model. The latent-action model compresses visual transitions into discrete codes; these codes are not inherently calibrated robot commands.

text.zh: 主模型11B；从较大网络游戏视频池筛选出约3万小时2D平台游戏视频，训练不需要动作或文字注释。另训RT-1机器人视频概念验证模型。
text.en: The main 11B model uses roughly 30,000 filtered hours of 2D platformer video, without action or text annotations. A separate robot-video model is trained on RT-1 as a proof of concept.

text.zh: 给定第一帧，编码为视觉tokens。用户选潜动作，动力学模型生成下一帧tokens，解码成图像，然后循环。文字通常先经图像生成模型变成初始图，并非直接等价于语言指令控制。
text.en: Encode a prompt frame into visual tokens. Select a latent action, predict next-frame tokens, decode pixels and repeat. Text can be converted to the initial image by another generator; it is not equivalent to language-conditioned robot control.

text.zh: 展示可控2D环境、RT-1机器人视频生成，以及从无动作视频到行为克隆的受控实验；不等于真机闭环机器人任务成功。
text.en: Evidence includes controllable 2D worlds, robot-video generation, and a controlled latent-action imitation experiment. It does not establish closed-loop physical robot success.

text.zh: 论文报告约1fps、16帧记忆，可能幻觉出不真实未来。短片看起来可控不意味着真实物理正确。
text.en: The paper reports around 1 fps and 16 frames of memory, with unrealistic hallucinated futures. Visually plausible control is not physical correctness.

text.zh: 生成的交互视觉环境；不是实测物理机器人执行。
text.en: Generated interactive visual environment; not measured physical robot execution.

text.zh: 官方描述为自回归潜扩散视频模型，输出连续观察画面；不要画成显式mesh物理引擎。
text.en: Officially described as an autoregressive latent-diffusion video model producing observations; do not depict it as an explicit mesh-based physics engine.

text.en: Initialize with an image; a person or agent supplies keyboard/mouse actions and the model generates subsequent observations.

text.zh: 官方展示同一初始画面不同动作分支、回访一致性和SIMA交互。
text.en: Official demos show action-dependent branches, revisitation consistency and SIMA interaction.

text.zh: 官方2024公告：一致环境最长约1分钟，多数展示10–20秒；展示不等于所有任意动作物理正确，也不是机器人实机评测。
text.en: The 2024 announcement reports up to one minute of consistency, with most examples lasting 10–20 seconds. Demos do not establish arbitrary-action physics or physical-robot performance.

text.zh: 按世界描述和用户动作逐帧生成；官方明确与依赖显式3D表示的NeRF/3DGS区分。无需猜测未披露网络结构。

text.zh: 此记录基于官方模型页和研究公告，训练细节披露有限。

text.zh: 导航控制之外，文本世界事件可改变天气或引入对象；世界事件不一定由环境内智能体自身执行。
text.en: Beyond navigation, text-prompted events can alter weather or introduce objects; such events are not necessarily actions performed by the embodied agent.

text.zh: 2025研究公告：720p、24fps、数分钟；当前模型页写20–24fps。SIMA在其虚拟世界中追求给定目标。
text.en: The 2025 announcement reports 720p, 24 fps and a few minutes. The current model page states 20–24 fps. SIMA pursues goals inside these virtual worlds.

description.zh: 用有限真实环境交互，学习一个可在其中训练策略的游戏模型。
description.en: Learn a game model in which a policy can train using limited real-environment interactions.

text.zh: 编码后的视觉观测 token 与环境动作。
text.en: Encoded visual-observation tokens and environment actions.

text.zh: 预测图像 token、奖励与回合终止；策略在学习的游戏环境中训练。
text.en: Predicted image tokens, rewards, and episode endings; an actor is trained in the learned game environment.

text.zh: 离散自编码器把图像压成tokens；GPT式Transformer自回归预测下一组图像tokens、奖励和终止。
text.en: A discrete autoencoder compresses images into tokens; a GPT-style Transformer predicts next image tokens, rewards and termination.

text.zh: 在Atari100k预算内交替采集数据、训练世界模型、用想象轨迹训练actor–critic策略。
text.en: Alternate data collection, world-model fitting and actor–critic training on imagined trajectories under the Atari 100k budget.

text.zh: 想象训练时先解码预测图像供策略选动作；真正游戏部署时使用训练后的策略，不需要每一步都展开搜索树。
text.en: During imagined training, decoded images feed the policy. At deployment in the actual game, the trained policy acts without a required per-step lookahead tree search.

text.zh: ICLR2023论文报告26款Atari的平均人类归一分数1.046；这是该论文协议下的游戏分数。
text.en: The ICLR 2023 paper reports mean human-normalized score 1.046 across 26 Atari games under its protocol.

text.zh: 离散压缩可能丢掉小物体和细微变化；新关卡等分布变化仍可能失败。不能把Atari人类归一分数换算成机器人成功率。
text.en: Discrete compression can lose small objects or subtle changes, and new levels can fail. Atari human-normalized score cannot be converted into robot success rate.

title.zh: DIAMOND
title.en: DIAMOND

description.zh: 世界模型丢掉一小块砖或奖励对象，会不会改变策略学到的行为？
description.en: Can losing a tiny brick or reward object change the policy that is learned?

text.zh: 过去观测与动作作为下一图像的条件；策略观察生成的游戏状态。
text.en: Past observations and actions condition the next image; the policy observes the generated game state.

text.zh: 扩散预测图像与奖励/终止预测；Atari 策略训练与真人控制 CS:GO 分开。
text.en: Diffusion-predicted images with reward/end predictions; Atari actor training is separate from human-controlled CS:GO.

text.zh: 条件扩散直接在像素空间预测下一帧；奖励与终止由另一个预测器处理。区分环境时间轴与每一步内部的去噪时间轴。
text.en: Conditional diffusion predicts the next frame in pixel space, with a separate reward/termination predictor. Distinguish environment time from denoising time within each transition.

text.zh: Atari分支交替采集真实环境数据、训练世界模型、在模型内训练策略；使用EDM设计，正式实验每帧3次去噪。CS:GO另用87小时静态人类游戏记录训练，不在其中训练RL策略。
text.en: The Atari branch alternates real-game data, model fitting and imagined policy training, using EDM and three denoising steps per frame. The separate CS:GO branch uses 87 hours of fixed human gameplay and does not train an RL policy.

text.zh: 输入历史图像和当前动作，从噪声逐步恢复下一帧。Atari由策略给动作；CS:GO演示由真人键鼠控制模型。
text.en: Given image history and an action, denoise a future frame. The Atari agent supplies actions; a human supplies keyboard/mouse inputs in the CS:GO demo.

text.zh: 论文Atari100k平均人类归一分数1.46，IQM0.64；与IRIS的定性对照统一用专家策略收集的10万帧训练，不能把图5当作所有场景的绝对排名。
text.en: The paper reports Atari 100k mean human-normalized score 1.46 and IQM 0.64. Its qualitative IRIS comparison trains both models on 100k frames collected with expert policies; Figure 5 is not a universal ranking.

text.zh: CS:GO项目页约10fps/RTX3090；不是机器人控制时延。允许连续多次跳跃等错误说明视觉逼真不保证游戏规则，更不保证真实物理。
text.en: The CS:GO project reports about 10 fps on an RTX 3090, not robot control latency. Repeated-jump errors show that visual realism does not guarantee game rules, let alone physical dynamics.

description.zh: 理解、视频生成、正逆动力学和策略能否共享一个模型骨干？
description.en: Can understanding, video generation, forward/inverse dynamics and policy share a backbone?

text.zh: 文本、视觉上下文和/或机器人动作，并按任务指定已观测与待预测模态。
text.en: Text, visual context, and/or robot actions with task-specific observed/predicted modality configuration.

text.zh: 按任务配置输出文字、图像/视频和/或动作；DROID 策略有独立真机证据。
text.en: Text, image/video, and/or actions according to task configuration; DROID policy has separate physical evidence.

text.zh: Mixture-of-Transformers共享注意力；AR部分承担理解/语言，扩散部分处理视觉、音频和动作。正动力学给动作生成视频；逆动力学给视觉变化求动作；policy模式同时预测视频与动作。
text.en: A Mixture-of-Transformers shares attention across an autoregressive reasoning/language stream and a diffusion stream for vision, audio and action. Forward dynamics predicts video from actions; inverse dynamics predicts actions from visual transitions; policy mode jointly predicts video and actions.

text.zh: 预训练→包含多个动作域的mid-training→具体域后训练。机器人例子是Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID，不能把其结果归给所有基础模型。
text.en: Pretraining → multidomain action mid-training → domain-specific post-training. The robot example is Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID; its results do not apply to every base checkpoint.

text.zh: 输入配置决定任务。动作/视频的联合生成可以给policy，而用已知动作生成视频只是在预测后果。
text.en: Input/output configuration defines the task. Joint action/video prediction may serve as a policy, while video prediction conditioned on known actions forecasts consequences.

text.zh: 2026报告区分DROID正动力学PSNR、RoboLab模拟成功率、RoboArena真机双盲配对偏好、MolmoSpaces模拟成功率。p69 Fig25有真机序列。
text.en: The 2026 report separates DROID forward-dynamics PSNR, RoboLab simulation success, RoboArena real-robot double-blind pairwise preference, and MolmoSpaces simulation success. Figure 25 on page 69 shows real-robot sequences.

text.zh: 排行榜是报告日期快照。PSNR、偏好评分、模拟成功率不是同一指标；视频和动作一致也不等于现实所有接触正确。官方演示文件明确4倍速，不能据此推出实时延迟。
text.en: Leaderboard claims are dated snapshots. PSNR, preference ratings and simulation success are incompatible metrics. Video-action agreement does not prove all real contact dynamics. The official demo is explicitly 4× speed and cannot establish raw latency.

description.zh: 如何把不同环境的任务统一为“从当前画面到达文字目标”，再连接各自的动作空间？
description.en: How can tasks across environments share a visual planning interface while retaining environment-specific actions?

text.zh: 当前图像与语言指令；逆动力学接收生成的视觉转移。
text.en: Current image and language instruction; inverse dynamics receives generated visual transitions.

text.zh: 视频计划，再由逆动力学输出动作；原报告实验采用开环执行。
text.en: Video plans, followed by inverse-dynamics actions; original reported experiments use open-loop execution.

text.zh: 视频帧序列表示计划；文字和第一帧约束视频扩散。第一帧沿时间平铺维持场景一致性，时间超分辨率将稀疏计划补成更密的帧。
text.en: Plans are frame sequences generated by text-and-first-frame-conditioned diffusion. Tiling the first frame stabilizes the scene; temporal super-resolution refines sparse plans.

text.zh: 视频规划器和小型任务相关IDM独立训练。IDM需要图像与动作监督，论文仿真使用七维机械臂控制；广域视觉预训练不能替代这层动作标定。
text.en: The video planner and small task-specific IDM are trained separately. The IDM needs image/action supervision; the simulated arm uses seven-dimensional controls. Broad visual pretraining does not remove this action grounding.

text.zh: 当前图像＋任务文字→视频计划→IDM推断动作序列→执行。框架允许重规划，但§3.2明确论文所有实验为了效率使用开环执行，不能画成已验证的逐步MPC。
text.en: Current image and instruction produce a video plan; the IDM converts it into an action sequence. Replanning is possible, but Section 3.2 explicitly says every reported experiment uses open-loop execution for efficiency.

text.zh: 仿真组合泛化、多任务任务完成率，与Transformer BC、Trajectory Transformer及Diffuser比较。真实画面的Bridge迁移评估是生成质量和生成视频末帧成功分类器；Table4的77.1%不是实际机器人完成率。
text.en: Simulation tests measure compositional and multitask completion against Transformer BC, Trajectory Transformer and Diffuser. Bridge transfer measures generated-video quality and a terminal-frame success classifier; Table 4’s 77.1% is not physical-robot completion.

text.zh: 生成高保真视频可耗时约一分钟；实验多为完全可观测，遮挡下可能编造物体或运动。视频计划合理不保证IDM能恢复唯一、可执行的控制。
text.en: High-fidelity generation can take roughly a minute. Mostly fully observed experiments leave partial-observation hallucinations unresolved. A plausible visual plan does not guarantee unique, executable inverse-dynamics controls.

title.zh: GR-2
title.en: GR-2

description.zh: 如何把海量网络视频里的时序知识迁移到机器人操作，同时保留动作生成能力？
description.en: How can temporal knowledge from large video collections transfer into a robot manipulation policy?

text.zh: 语言与近期机器人图像/状态，遵循论文具体机器人接口。
text.en: Language and recent robot images/state under the reported robot-specific interface.

text.zh: 并行未来视频与动作预测，动作部分包含条件变分组件。
text.en: Parallel future-video and action predictions, with a conditional variational action component.

text.zh: 冻结文字编码器和VQGAN图像tokenizer；GPT式主干处理语言、多视角图像、末端位置/旋转及夹爪状态。cVAE产生动作轨迹，视觉分支预测未来图像。
text.en: Frozen text and VQGAN image encoders feed a GPT-style backbone alongside end-effector pose and gripper state. A conditional VAE produces action trajectories; a visual branch predicts future images.

text.zh: 先在3800万文本视频片段、约500亿token上学习预测；数据含人类活动及RT-1、Bridge机器人视频。再用机器人轨迹同时训练视频和动作，不能说预训练全是非机器人视频。
text.en: Pretrain prediction on 38 million text/video clips, roughly 50 billion tokens, including human activities and RT-1/Bridge robot data. Robot fine-tuning predicts videos and actions together; pretraining is not exclusively non-robot footage.

text.zh: 语言＋历史画面＋机器人状态直接生成动作轨迹。Kinova Gen3真机将笛卡尔轨迹平滑后，由WBC转为关节控制；200Hz是底层执行频率，不是GR-2模型生成频率。
text.en: Language, visual history and robot state produce an action trajectory directly. On Kinova Gen3, WBC smooths Cartesian trajectories and converts them to joint control; 200 Hz is low-level execution, not model inference rate.

text.zh: Kinova Gen3＋Robotiq2F-85、头部与腕部双相机；105个桌面任务，约4万演示及约八分之一低数据版本。另有122物体分箱抓取和CALVIN ABCD-D：1000条五任务链；这些协议不能合并成一个成功率。
text.en: Physical tests use Kinova Gen3, Robotiq 2F-85 and head/wrist cameras: 105 tabletop tasks with roughly 40,000 demonstrations and a one-eighth-data variant. Separate tests cover 122 bin-picking objects and 1,000 five-task CALVIN ABCD-D chains.

text.zh: 生成视频与实际动作的相关性不等于显式搜索候选动作；报告中未据此证明在线MPC。真实桌面泛化、分箱抓取、CALVIN仿真的指标与训练预算分别解释。
text.en: Correlation between generated video and executed actions does not establish explicit candidate-action search or online MPC. Real tabletop, bin-picking and simulated CALVIN results retain separate metrics and data budgets.

description.zh: 能否用计算扩充机器人行为与场景数据，减少逐任务采集新遥操作轨迹？
description.en: Can compute expand robot behaviors and environments without teleoperating every new task?

text.zh: 目标机器人适配数据，以及离线合成轨迹所需起始图像与语言。
text.en: Target-robot adaptation data, then initial images and language for offline synthetic trajectories.

text.zh: 带伪动作标签的合成机器人轨迹，用于离线训练下游执行策略。
text.en: Pseudolabeled synthetic robot trajectories used to train a downstream execution policy offline.

text.zh: neural trajectory指生成的图像序列及推断动作，不是真实执行记录。四阶段：适配视频模型、生成视频、标注伪动作、训练视觉动作策略。
text.en: A neural trajectory pairs generated frames with inferred actions; it is not a recorded execution. Four stages adapt a video model, generate videos, label pseudo-actions and train a visuomotor policy.

text.zh: 默认LoRA适配视频模型，多数下游实验用WAN2.1。IDM用两帧、SigLIP-2与扩散Transformer，以流匹配学习中间动作块；LAM用VQ-VAE学习视觉变化，潜动作并非直接标定的控制命令。真实与合成共同训练时采样比为1:1。
text.en: Default adaptation uses LoRA, usually on WAN 2.1. A SigLIP-2/diffusion-transformer IDM learns action chunks between two frames with flow matching. The VQ-VAE latent-action model captures visual change, not inherently calibrated controls. Real/synthetic co-training uses a 1:1 sampling ratio.

text.zh: 生成和IDM标注在训练前离线完成；部署时运行训练好的视觉动作策略。合成轨迹没有本体状态，训练时对应状态输入置零。新场景仍需人工提供初始图像和任务文字。
text.en: Generation and IDM labeling happen offline before policy training; deployment runs the resulting visuomotor policy. Synthetic trajectories lack proprioception, so their state input is zeroed. New scenes still need manually supplied initial images and instructions.

text.zh: RoboCasa仿真扩充及GR1、Franka、SO-100九项真实任务。新行为实验先用约2884条GR1取放轨迹适配，再每项生成50条合成轨迹；Table1有分段得分，不能当作全任务二元成功率。DreamGen Bench评的是视频指令/物理合理性。
text.en: Evidence includes RoboCasa augmentation and nine physical tasks across GR1, Franka and SO-100. Novel-behavior experiments adapt on roughly 2,884 GR1 pick/place trajectories and generate 50 synthetic trajectories per task. Table 1 permits partial credit; DreamGen Bench scores video instruction/physics following.

text.zh: 零样本新行为不等于没有目标机器人数据；零真实数据的新机型泛化仍待解决。初始画面需人工、任务相对简单、自动视频评估会幻觉；24万RoboCasa样本报告耗1500块L40运行54小时。
text.en: Novel-behavior transfer does not mean zero target-robot data; zero-data embodiment transfer remains open. Initial frames require manual work, tasks are relatively simple, and video evaluators can hallucinate. The reported 240,000-sample RoboCasa set used 1,500 L40 GPUs for 54 hours.

title.zh: WorldVLA (original arXiv v1)
title.en: WorldVLA (original arXiv v1)

description.zh: 能否让动作理解和视觉动态预测在同一模型中互相帮助，并减少动作块自回归误差累积？
description.en: Can policy learning and visual dynamics prediction improve each other within one model while reducing action-chunk error accumulation?

text.zh: 固定原版模型中的语言、视觉观测，以及视觉/动作 token 序列。
text.en: Language, visual observations, and visual/action token sequences in the fixed original model.

text.zh: 联合建模视觉/动作序列；动作预测在原 LIBERO 协议下测试。
text.en: Jointly modeled visual/action sequences; action predictions are tested under the original LIBERO protocol.

text.zh: 从Chameleon初始化，图像、文字和动作各自token化。每步动作七个token：三维相对位置、三维相对角度、绝对夹爪状态；每个连续维度离散成256档。
text.en: Initialized from Chameleon, the model tokenizes images, text and actions. Each action has seven tokens: relative position, relative angles and absolute gripper state, with 256 bins per continuous dimension.

text.zh: 混合两类序列：图像＋任务→动作；图像＋动作→下一图像。对应交叉熵Laction＋αLworld，默认α=0.04。动作块屏蔽对先前动作的注意力、保留文字视觉条件；世界模型仍用因果注意力。
text.en: Training mixes image/task-to-action and image/action-to-next-image sequences with cross-entropy Laction + αLworld, default α=0.04. The action-chunk mask removes access to prior actions while retaining text/vision; the world-model branch keeps causal attention.

text.zh: 动作模式读取历史图像与任务输出动作块；世界模式给定图像及动作预测视觉结果。原论文报告的是训练共享和LIBERO策略评估，未给出经验证的在线候选动作搜索/MPC流程。
text.en: Policy mode maps visual history and instructions to action chunks; world mode predicts visual outcomes from images and actions. The original evidence is shared training and LIBERO policy evaluation, not a validated online candidate-search/MPC procedure.

text.zh: LIBERO仿真每任务50次rollout；视觉评估用留出数据的FVD、PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS。默认90/10训练验证拆分，但Table2使用全部数据训练；内部消融与主表协议不能混同。未做大规模机器人预训练不等于没有Chameleon视觉语言预训练。
text.en: LIBERO simulation uses 50 rollouts per task; held-out visual evaluation uses FVD, PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS. The default 90/10 split differs from Table 2, which trains on all data. No large-scale robot pretraining does not mean no Chameleon vision/language pretraining.

text.zh: 离散图像tokenizer的感知表达受限，长动作块降低对新观测的反应；原版没有真机证据。本记录固定2506.21539v1，后续仓库更名或RynnVLA-002内容不追溯套用。
text.en: Discrete visual tokenization limits perception, and long action chunks reduce responsiveness to new observations. The original paper has no physical-robot evaluation. Claims are pinned to 2506.21539v1, excluding later repository renames or RynnVLA-002 material.
